Sempurna! Sekarang saya juga perlu tambahkan validasi serupa saat user sedang menggunakan aplikasi. Mari saya buat utility function untuk logout yang bisa dipakai di mana saja:

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'dart:convert';
import '../../config/environment.dart';

class AuthHelper {
  /// Validate apakah user masih exist di database
  static Future<bool> validateUser(int userId, String token) async {
    try {
      final response = await http.get(
        Uri.parse('${Environment.baseUrl}/users/$userId'),
        headers: {
          'Accept': 'application/json',
          'Authorization': 'Bearer $token',
        },
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final data = json.decode(response.body);
        return data['success'] == true;
      } else if (response.statusCode == 404) {
        // User sudah dihapus
        return false;
      } else if (response.statusCode == 401) {
        // Token invalid atau expired
        return false;
      } else {
        // Error lain, assume masih valid (untuk offline support)
        return true;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Network error - assume masih valid (offline scenario)
      if (Environment.isDebug) {
        print('Error validating user: $e');
      }
      return true;
    }
  }

  /// Logout user dan clear semua data
  static Future<void> logout(BuildContext context, {String? reason}) async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final token = prefs.getString('auth_token');

      // Call logout API jika ada token
      if (token != null) {
        try {
          await http.post(
            Uri.parse('${Environment.baseUrl}/logout'),
            headers: {
              'Accept': 'application/json',
              'Authorization': 'Bearer $token',
            },
          ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 3));
        } catch (e) {
          // Ignore error saat logout API call
          if (Environment.isDebug) {
            print('Error calling logout API: $e');
          }
        }
      }

      // Clear all user data
      await clearUserData();

      // Navigate to login
      if (context.mounted) {
        Navigator.pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(context, '/login', (route) => false);

        // Show message if reason provided
        if (reason != null) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(
              content: Text(reason),
              backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
              duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (Environment.isDebug) {
        print('Error during logout: $e');
      }
    }
  }

  /// Clear semua data user dari SharedPreferences
  static Future<void> clearUserData() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove('auth_token');
    await prefs.remove('user_id');
    await prefs.remove('user_name');
    await prefs.remove('user_username');
    await prefs.remove('user_phone');
    await prefs.remove('user_role');
    await prefs.remove('last_assignment_refresh');

    if (Environment.isDebug) {
      print('User data cleared from SharedPreferences');
    }
  }

  /// Get current user data dari SharedPreferences
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> getCurrentUser() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final token = prefs.getString('auth_token');
    final userId = prefs.getInt('user_id');
    final userName = prefs.getString('user_name');
    final userRole = prefs.getString('user_role');

    if (token != null && userId != null) {
      return {
        'token': token,
        'user_id': userId,
        'user_name': userName,
        'user_role': userRole,
      };
    }

    return null;
  }

  /// Check apakah user sedang login
  static Future<bool> isLoggedIn() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final token = prefs.getString('auth_token');
    final userId = prefs.getInt('user_id');
    return token != null && userId != null;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class SplashScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SplashScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<SplashScreen> createState() => _SplashScreenState();
}

class _SplashScreenState extends State<SplashScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _animationController;
  late Animation<double> _logoAnimation;
  late Animation<double> _textAnimation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    // Setup animations
    _animationController = AnimationController(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 2000),
      vsync: this,
    );

    _logoAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(
        parent: _animationController,
        curve: const Interval(0.0, 0.6, curve: Curves.easeOut),
      ),
    );

    _textAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(
        parent: _animationController,
        curve: const Interval(0.4, 1.0, curve: Curves.easeInOut),
      ),
    );

    // Start animations
    _animationController.forward();

    // Navigate after delay
    _navigateToNextScreen();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _animationController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _navigateToNextScreen() async {
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 3000));

    if (!mounted) return;

    // Check if user is already logged in
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final token = prefs.getString('auth_token');
    final userRole = prefs.getString('user_role');
    final userId = prefs.getInt('user_id');

    if (token != null && userRole != null && userId != null) {
      // Validate user masih exist di database
      final isValidUser = await _validateUser(userId, token);

      if (isValidUser && mounted) {
        // User valid, navigate to appropriate dashboard
        if (userRole == 'admin') {
          Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/admin');
        } else {
          Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/user');
        }
      } else {
        // User tidak valid (sudah dihapus), logout dan clear data
        await _clearUserData();
        if (mounted) {
          Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/login');
        }
      }
    } else {
      // User not logged in, navigate to login
      Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/login');
    }
  }

  /// Validate apakah user masih exist di database
  Future<bool> _validateUser(int userId, String token) async {
    try {
      final response = await http.get(
        Uri.parse('${Environment.baseUrl}/users/$userId'),
        headers: {
          'Accept': 'application/json',
          'Authorization': 'Bearer $token',
        },
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final data = json.decode(response.body);
        // User masih ada
        return data['success'] == true;
      } else {
        // User tidak ditemukan (404) atau error lain
        return false;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Network error atau timeout - biarkan user tetap login (offline scenario)
      // Hanya logout jika explicit 404 atau 401
      if (Environment.isDebug) {
        print('Error validating user: $e');
      }
      // Return true untuk allow offline access
      return true;
    }
  }

  /// Clear semua data user dari SharedPreferences
  Future<void> _clearUserData() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove('auth_token');
    await prefs.remove('user_id');
    await prefs.remove('user_name');
    await prefs.remove('user_username');
    await prefs.remove('user_phone');
    await prefs.remove('user_role');

    if (Environment.isDebug) {
      print('User data cleared - user sudah tidak exist di database');
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: Container(
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(gradient: AppColors.backgroundGradient),
        child: SafeArea(
          child: SizedBox(
            width: double.infinity,
            height: double.infinity,
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,

                  // Logo Animation

                      final scale = _logoAnimation.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0);

                      return Transform.scale(

class ProfileController extends GetxController {

  final oldPasswordController = TextEditingController();

  final confirmPasswordController = TextEditingController();

    super.onInit();
    loadUserData();

    oldPasswordController.dispose();
    newPasswordController.dispose();
    confirmPasswordController.dispose();
    super.onClose();
  }

  Future<void> loadUserData() async {
    try {
      isLoading.value = true;
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final name = prefs.getString('user_name');
      final phone = prefs.getString('user_phone');
      final id = prefs.getInt('user_id');

      if (name != null && name.isNotEmpty) {
        userName.value = name;

      if (phone != null && phone.isNotEmpty) {
        userPhone.value = phone;

      if (id != null) {
        userId.value = id.toString();

  Widget _buildInfoRow(String label, String value, IconData icon) {
    return Row(

          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

              Text(

  Widget _buildPasswordField({
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required String label,
    required IconData icon,
  }) {
    return TextFormField(
      controller: controller,
      obscureText: true,
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        prefixIcon: Icon(icon, size: 20),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF9C27B0)),
        ),
        filled: true,
        fillColor: Colors.grey[50],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _changePassword(BuildContext context) async {
    // Validasi input
    if (oldPasswordController.text.isEmpty ||
        newPasswordController.text.isEmpty ||
        confirmPasswordController.text.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar(
        'Error',
        'Semua field harus diisi',
        backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        colorText: Colors.white,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text != confirmPasswordController.text) {
      Get.snackbar(
        'Error',
        'Konfirmasi password tidak sama',
        backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        colorText: Colors.white,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text.length < 6) {
      Get.snackbar(
        'Error',
        'Password baru minimal 6 karakter',
        backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        colorText: Colors.white,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (userId.value.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar(
        'Error',
        'User ID tidak ditemukan',
        backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        colorText: Colors.white,
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      isLoading.value = true;

      // Panggil API change password
      final response = await http.put(
        Uri.parse(
          'http://192.168.1.100:8000/api/users/${userId.value}/change-password',
        ),
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Accept': 'application/json',
        },
        body: json.encode({
          'old_password': oldPasswordController.text,
          'new_password': newPasswordController.text,
          'confirm_password': confirmPasswordController.text,
        }),
      );

      final responseData = json.decode(response.body);

      if (response.statusCode == 200 && responseData['success'] == true) {
        // Tutup dialog
        Navigator.of(context).pop();

        // Clear form
        oldPasswordController.clear();
        newPasswordController.clear();
        confirmPasswordController.clear();

        // Tampilkan pesan sukses
        Get.snackbar(
          'Sukses',
          responseData['message'] ?? 'Password berhasil diubah',
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
          colorText: Colors.white,
        );
      } else {
        // Tampilkan error dari server
        String errorMessage = 'Gagal mengubah password';
        if (responseData['message'] != null) {
          errorMessage = responseData['message'];
        } else if (responseData['errors'] != null) {
          final errors = responseData['errors'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
          errorMessage = errors.values.first[0];
        }

        Get.snackbar(
          'Error',
          errorMessage,
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
          colorText: Colors.white,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Get.snackbar(
        'Error',
        'Terjadi kesalahan: ${e.toString()}',
        backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        colorText: Colors.white,
      );
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> performLogout() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.clear();

      // Clear home data saat logout
      if (Get.isRegistered<HomeController>()) {
        Get.find<HomeController>().clearData();
      }

      // Navigate to login and clear all previous routes
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    } catch (e) {
      print('Logout error: ${e.toString()}');
      // Still navigate even if there's an error clearing prefs
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    }
  }

  Future<void> refreshData() async {
    await loadUserData();
  }
}

  Future<void> loadUserData() async {
    try {
      isLoading.value = true;
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final name = prefs.getString('user_name');
      final phone = prefs.getString('user_phone');
      final id = prefs.getInt('user_id');

      if (name != null && name.isNotEmpty) {
        userName.value = name;
      }
      if (phone != null && phone.isNotEmpty) {
        userPhone.value = phone;
      }
      if (id != null) {
        userId.value = id.toString();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error loading user data: $e');
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  Widget _buildPasswordField({
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required String label,
    required IconData icon,
  }) {
    return TextFormField(
      controller: controller,
      obscureText: true,
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        prefixIcon: Icon(icon, size: 20),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF9C27B0)),
        ),
        filled: true,
        fillColor: Colors.grey[50],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _changePassword(BuildContext context) async {
    // Validasi input
    if (oldPasswordController.text.isEmpty ||
        newPasswordController.text.isEmpty ||
        confirmPasswordController.text.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar(
        'Error',
        'Semua field harus diisi',
        backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        colorText: Colors.white,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text != confirmPasswordController.text) {
      Get.snackbar(
        'Error',
        'Konfirmasi password tidak sama',
        backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        colorText: Colors.white,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text.length < 6) {
      Get.snackbar(
        'Error',
        'Password baru minimal 6 karakter',
        backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        colorText: Colors.white,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (userId.value.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar(
        'Error',
        'User ID tidak ditemukan',
        backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        colorText: Colors.white,
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      isLoading.value = true;

      // Panggil API change password
      final response = await http.put(
        Uri.parse(
          'http://192.168.1.100:8000/api/users/${userId.value}/change-password',
        ),
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Accept': 'application/json',
        },
        body: json.encode({
          'old_password': oldPasswordController.text,
          'new_password': newPasswordController.text,
          'confirm_password': confirmPasswordController.text,
        }),
      );

      final responseData = json.decode(response.body);

      if (response.statusCode == 200 && responseData['success'] == true) {
        // Tutup dialog
        Navigator.of(context).pop();

        // Clear form
        oldPasswordController.clear();
        newPasswordController.clear();
        confirmPasswordController.clear();

        // Tampilkan pesan sukses
        Get.snackbar(
          'Sukses',
          responseData['message'] ?? 'Password berhasil diubah',
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
          colorText: Colors.white,
        );
      } else {
        // Tampilkan error dari server
        String errorMessage = 'Gagal mengubah password';
        if (responseData['message'] != null) {
          errorMessage = responseData['message'];
        } else if (responseData['errors'] != null) {
          final errors = responseData['errors'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
          errorMessage = errors.values.first[0];
        }

        Get.snackbar(
          'Error',
          errorMessage,
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
          colorText: Colors.white,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Get.snackbar(
        'Error',
        'Terjadi kesalahan: ${e.toString()}',
        backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        colorText: Colors.white,
      );
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> performLogout() async {
    try {
      // Clear home data saat logout
      if (Get.isRegistered<HomeController>()) {
        Get.find<HomeController>().clearData();
      }

      // Use AuthHelper untuk logout yang lebih robust
      if (Get.context != null) {
        await AuthHelper.logout(Get.context!);
      } else {
        // Fallback jika context tidak tersedia
        await AuthHelper.clearUserData();
        Get.offAllNamed('/login');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Logout error: ${e.toString()}');
      // Still navigate even if there's an error
      await AuthHelper.clearUserData();
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    }
  }

  Future<void> refreshData() async {
    await loadUserData();
  }
}

Perfect! Sekarang saya check linter dan buat dokumentasi singkat:

```markdown
# ✅ PERBAIKAN AUTO-LOGIN & VALIDASI USER

## 🔍 MASALAH

Saat `flutter run`, aplikasi masih auto-login dengan akun yang sudah dihapus dari database. User seharusnya di-logout otomatis jika akun sudah tidak valid.

**Penyebab:**
- Splash screen hanya check `SharedPreferences` tapi TIDAK validasi ke backend
- Tidak ada mekanisme untuk validate apakah user masih exist di database

---

## ✅ SOLUSI

### 1. Buat Helper Class untuk Authentication (`AuthHelper`)

**File Baru**: `lib/core/utils/auth_helper.dart`

**Fitur:**
- ✅ `validateUser()` - Validasi user masih exist di database via API
- ✅ `logout()` - Logout user dan clear semua data
- ✅ `clearUserData()` - Clear SharedPreferences
- ✅ `getCurrentUser()` - Get data user yang sedang login
- ✅ `isLoggedIn()` - Check apakah user sedang login

**Logic Validasi:**
```dart
Future<bool> validateUser(int userId, String token) async {
  // Hit API /users/{id}
  // - 200: User masih ada ✅
  // - 404: User sudah dihapus ❌
  // - 401: Token invalid ❌
  // - Network error: Assume valid (offline support) ✅
}
```

---

### 2. Update Splash Screen dengan Validasi

**File Diubah**: `lib/presentation/screens/splash/splash_screen.dart`

**Perubahan:**
```dart
// SEBELUM ❌
if (token != null && userRole != null) {
  // Langsung navigate tanpa validasi
  Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/admin');
}

// SESUDAH ✅
if (token != null && userRole != null && userId != null) {
  // Validate user masih exist
  final isValidUser = await AuthHelper.validateUser(userId, token);
  
  if (isValidUser) {
    // User valid, navigate
    Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/admin');
  } else {
    // User tidak valid, clear data & ke login
    await AuthHelper.clearUserData();
    Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/login');
    
    // Show message
    SnackBar(content: Text('Akun Anda sudah tidak aktif'));
  }
}
```

---

### 3. Update Profile Controller untuk Logout

**File Diubah**: `lib/presentation/screens/user/modules/profile/controllers/profile_controller.dart`

**Perubahan:**
```dart
// SEBELUM ❌
Future<void> performLogout() async {
  final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
  await prefs.clear();
  Get.offAllNamed('/login');
}

// SESUDAH ✅
Future<void> performLogout() async {
  // Clear home data
  if (Get.isRegistered<HomeController>()) {
    Get.find<HomeController>().clearData();
  }
  
  // Use AuthHelper untuk logout yang robust
  await AuthHelper.logout(Get.context!);
}
```

---

## 🎯 ALUR KERJA

### Scenario 1: User Masih Valid
```
App Start
  → Splash Screen
  → Read SharedPreferences (token, userId, role)
  → Validate ke Backend: GET /users/{userId}
  → Response 200 ✅
  → Navigate to Dashboard
```

### Scenario 2: User Sudah Dihapus
```
App Start
  → Splash Screen
  → Read SharedPreferences (token, userId, role)
  → Validate ke Backend: GET /users/{userId}
  → Response 404 ❌
  → Clear SharedPreferences
  → Navigate to Login
  → Show SnackBar: "Akun Anda sudah tidak aktif"
```

### Scenario 3: Offline / Network Error
```
App Start
  → Splash Screen
  → Read SharedPreferences (token, userId, role)
  → Validate ke Backend: GET /users/{userId}
  → Network Error ⚠️
  → Assume Valid (offline support)
  → Navigate to Dashboard
```

---

## 📁 FILE YANG DIUBAH

### File Baru:
1. ✅ `lib/core/utils/auth_helper.dart` - Helper class untuk authentication

### File Diubah:
1. ✅ `lib/presentation/screens/splash/splash_screen.dart` - Tambah validasi user
2. ✅ `lib/presentation/screens/user/modules/profile/controllers/profile_controller.dart` - Update logout

## 💡 KEUNTUNGAN

2. ✅ **UX**: User langsung tahu jika akunnya tidak aktif

```dart

  @override

          backgroundColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.7), // Dark overlay

              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                // Header
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),

                        color: const Color(0xFF4CAF50).withOpacity(0.1),

                      onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
                      style: IconButton.styleFrom(padding: EdgeInsets.zero, minimumSize: const Size(32, 32)),
                    ),

                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),

                // Input Field
                TextField(

                    newItem = value;
                  },
                  decoration: InputDecoration(

                    prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.cleaning_services, color: Color(0xFF4CAF50)),
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Colors.grey),
                    ),
                    focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF4CAF50), width: 2),
                    ),
                    enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
                    ),
                    filled: true,
                    fillColor: Colors.grey.shade50,
                  ),
                  autofocus: true,
                  maxLines: 2,
                  minLines: 1,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),

                // Action Buttons
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: TextButton(
                        onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                        style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            side: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: const Text(
                          'Batal',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: Colors.grey),

                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    Expanded(
                      child: ElevatedButton(
                        onPressed: () {
                          if (newItem.trim().isNotEmpty) {
                            setState(() {
                              _kebersihanList.add(newItem.trim());
                            });
                            Navigator.of(context).pop();
                          }
                        },
                        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
                          foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                          elevation: 2,
                        ),
                        child: const Text('Tambah', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  void _removeKebersihanItem(int index) {
    setState(() {
      _kebersihanList.removeAt(index);
    });
  }

  void _handleSubmit() async {
    if (_formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
      bool success;

      if (widget.area == null) {
        success = await widget.controller.addArea(
          _namaAreaController.text.trim(),
          _selectedLantai!,
          _nomorRuanganController.text.trim(),
          List.from(_kebersihanList),
          _keteranganController.text.trim(),
        );
      } else {
        success = await widget.controller.updateArea(
          widget.area!.id,
          _namaAreaController.text.trim(),
          _selectedLantai!,
          _nomorRuanganController.text.trim(),
          List.from(_kebersihanList),
          _keteranganController.text.trim(),
        );
      }

      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.of(context).pop();

        if (success) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(
              content: Text('Area berhasil ${widget.area == null ? 'ditambahkan' : 'diupdate'}!'),
              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
            ),
          );
        } else {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(
            context,
          ).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Gagal memproses area'), backgroundColor: Colors.red));
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

  Widget _buildSettingsCard({

  void _showLogoutConfirmation() {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext context) {
        return Dialog(

                Container(

                    color: Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),

                  ),
                ),

                const Text(

  Future<void> _performLogout() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.clear();

      // Navigate to login and clear all previous routes
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    } catch (e) {
      print('Logout error: ${e.toString()}');
      // Still navigate even if there's an error clearing prefs
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    }
  }
}

  Widget _buildSecurityButton(String label, Color color) {
    return SizedBox(
      width: double.infinity,
      child: OutlinedButton(
        onPressed: () {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(

        child: Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(
            color: color,
            fontSize: 14,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLogoutButton() {
    return SizedBox(
      width: double.infinity,
      child: OutlinedButton(
        onPressed: () => _showLogoutConfirmation(),
        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
          side: const BorderSide(color: Colors.red),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
        ),
        child: const Text(
          'Logout',
          style: TextStyle(
            color: Colors.red,
            fontSize: 14,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showLogoutConfirmation() {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext context) {
        return Dialog(
          backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          ),
          child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.white,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              boxShadow: [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                  blurRadius: 15,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 5),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                // Icon
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                  child: const Icon(Icons.logout, color: Colors.red, size: 32),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                // Title
                const Text(
                  'Konfirmasi Logout',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 18,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: Colors.black87,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                // Content
                const Text(
                  'Apakah Anda yakin ingin keluar?',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.black54),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),
                // Buttons
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: OutlinedButton(
                        onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          ),
                          side: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
                        ),
                        child: const Text(
                          'Batal',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: Colors.black87,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    Expanded(
                      child: ElevatedButton(
                        onPressed: () async {
                          Navigator.of(context).pop();
                          await _performLogout();
                        },
                        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
                          foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: const Text(
                          'Logout',
                          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _performLogout() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.clear();

      // Navigate to login and clear all previous routes
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    } catch (e) {
      print('Logout error: ${e.toString()}');
      // Still navigate even if there's an error clearing prefs
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    }
  }
}

                              style: TextStyle(

                              ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 12),

          ...children,
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildGenerateTaskButton() {
    return SizedBox(
      width: double.infinity,
      child: ElevatedButton.icon(
        onPressed: () => _generateDailyAssignments(),
        icon: const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome, size: 20),
        label: const Text(
          'Generate Tugas Hari Ini',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
        ),
        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
          foregroundColor: Colors.white,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
          elevation: 2,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _generateDailyAssignments() async {
    try {
      // Show loading
      showDialog(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: false,
        builder: (context) => const Center(
          child: CircularProgressIndicator(
            valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(Colors.white),
          ),
        ),
      );

      final response = await http.post(
        Uri.parse('${Environment.baseUrl}/assignments/generate-daily'),
        headers: {
          'Accept': 'application/json',
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      // Close loading
      Navigator.pop(context);

      final data = json.decode(response.body);

      if (response.statusCode == 200 && data['success'] == true) {
        final created = data['data']['created'] ?? 0;
        final skipped = data['data']['skipped'] ?? 0;

        showDialog(
          context: context,
          builder: (BuildContext context) {
            return Dialog(
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              ),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                ),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: const Color(0xFF4CAF50).withOpacity(0.1),
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      ),
                      child: const Icon(
                        Icons.check_circle,
                        color: Color(0xFF4CAF50),
                        size: 48,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    const Text(
                      'Berhasil!',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 20,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    Text(
                      'Tugas harian berhasil di-generate',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 14,
                        color: Colors.grey[600],
                      ),
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.grey[100],
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      ),
                      child: Column(
                        children: [
                          Row(
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                            children: [
                              const Text('Tugas dibuat:'),
                              Text(
                                '$created',
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  color: Color(0xFF4CAF50),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Row(
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                            children: [
                              const Text('Sudah ada:'),
                              Text(
                                '$skipped',
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  color: Colors.orange,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 20),
                    SizedBox(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      child: ElevatedButton(
                        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: const Text(
                          'Tutup',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: Colors.white,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      } else {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(data['message'] ?? 'Gagal generate tugas'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Close loading if still open
      Navigator.pop(context);
      
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('Error: ${e.toString()}'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Widget _buildTimeSelector(String label, String startTime, String endTime) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          label,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: 16,
                  vertical: 12,
                ),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                  children: [
                    Text(startTime, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14)),
                    const Icon(Icons.access_time, size: 20, color: Colors.grey),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 16),
            Expanded(

                  vertical: 12,
                ),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,

  Future<void> _performLogout() async {

      await prefs.clear();

      // Navigate to login and clear all previous routes
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');

      Get.offAllNamed('/login');

  }

  Widget _buildPasswordField({
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required String label,
    required IconData icon,
  }) {
    return TextFormField(
      controller: controller,
      obscureText: true,
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        prefixIcon: Icon(icon, size: 20),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF9C27B0)),
        ),
        filled: true,
        fillColor: Colors.grey[50],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _changePassword(BuildContext context) async {
    // Validasi input
    if (oldPasswordController.text.isEmpty ||
        newPasswordController.text.isEmpty ||
        confirmPasswordController.text.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Semua field harus diisi', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text != confirmPasswordController.text) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Konfirmasi password tidak sama', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text.length < 6) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Password baru minimal 6 karakter', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (userId.value.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'User ID tidak ditemukan', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    try {
      isLoading.value = true;

      // Panggil API change password menggunakan Environment
      final response = await http.put(
        Uri.parse('${Environment.baseUrl.replaceAll('/api', '')}/api/users/${userId.value}/change-password'),
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json'},
        body: json.encode({
          'old_password': oldPasswordController.text,
          'new_password': newPasswordController.text,
          'confirm_password': confirmPasswordController.text,
        }),
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      final responseData = json.decode(response.body);

      if (response.statusCode == 200 && responseData['success'] == true) {
        // Tutup dialog
        Navigator.of(context).pop();

        // Clear form
        oldPasswordController.clear();
        newPasswordController.clear();
        confirmPasswordController.clear();

        // Tampilkan pesan sukses
        Get.snackbar(
          'Sukses',
          responseData['message'] ?? 'Password berhasil diubah',
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
          colorText: Colors.white,
        );
      } else {
        // Tampilkan error dari server
        String errorMessage = 'Gagal mengubah password';
        if (responseData['message'] != null) {
          errorMessage = responseData['message'];
        } else if (responseData['errors'] != null) {
          final errors = responseData['errors'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
          errorMessage = errors.values.first[0];
        }

        Get.snackbar('Error', errorMessage, backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Terjadi kesalahan: ${e.toString()}', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> performLogout() async {
    try {
      // Clear home data saat logout
      if (Get.isRegistered<HomeController>()) {
        Get.find<HomeController>().clearData();
      }

      // Use AuthHelper untuk logout yang lebih robust
      if (Get.context != null) {
        await AuthHelper.logout(Get.context!);
      } else {
        // Fallback jika context tidak tersedia
        await AuthHelper.clearUserData();
        Get.offAllNamed('/login');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Logout error: ${e.toString()}');
      // Still navigate even if there's an error
      await AuthHelper.clearUserData();
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    }
  }

  Future<void> refreshData() async {
    await loadUserData();
  }
}

  Widget _buildPasswordField({
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required String label,
    required IconData icon,
  }) {
    return TextFormField(
      controller: controller,
      obscureText: true,
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        prefixIcon: Icon(icon, size: 20),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF9C27B0)),
        ),
        filled: true,
        fillColor: Colors.grey[50],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _changePassword(BuildContext context) async {
    // Validasi input
    if (oldPasswordController.text.isEmpty ||
        newPasswordController.text.isEmpty ||
        confirmPasswordController.text.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Semua field harus diisi', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text != confirmPasswordController.text) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Konfirmasi password tidak sama', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text.length < 6) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Password baru minimal 6 karakter', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (userId.value.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'User ID tidak ditemukan', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    try {
      isLoading.value = true;

      // Panggil API change password menggunakan Environment
      final response = await http.put(
        Uri.parse('${Environment.baseUrl.replaceAll('/api', '')}/api/users/${userId.value}/change-password'),
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json'},
        body: json.encode({
          'old_password': oldPasswordController.text,
          'new_password': newPasswordController.text,
          'confirm_password': confirmPasswordController.text,
        }),
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      final responseData = json.decode(response.body);

      if (response.statusCode == 200 && responseData['success'] == true) {
        // Tutup dialog
        Navigator.of(context).pop();

        // Clear form
        oldPasswordController.clear();
        newPasswordController.clear();
        confirmPasswordController.clear();

        // Tampilkan pesan sukses
        Get.snackbar(
          'Sukses',
          responseData['message'] ?? 'Password berhasil diubah',
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
          colorText: Colors.white,
        );
      } else {
        // Tampilkan error dari server
        String errorMessage = 'Gagal mengubah password';
        if (responseData['message'] != null) {
          errorMessage = responseData['message'];
        } else if (responseData['errors'] != null) {
          final errors = responseData['errors'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
          errorMessage = errors.values.first[0];
        }

        Get.snackbar('Error', errorMessage, backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Terjadi kesalahan: ${e.toString()}', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> performLogout() async {
    try {
      // Clear home data saat logout
      if (Get.isRegistered<HomeController>()) {
        Get.find<HomeController>().clearData();
      }

      // Use AuthHelper untuk logout yang lebih robust
      if (Get.context != null) {
        await AuthHelper.logout(Get.context!);
      } else {
        // Fallback jika context tidak tersedia
        await AuthHelper.clearUserData();
        Get.offAllNamed('/login');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Logout error: ${e.toString()}');
      // Still navigate even if there's an error
      await AuthHelper.clearUserData();
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    }
  }

  Future<void> refreshData() async {
    await loadUserData();
  }
}

          backgroundColor: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.7), // Dark overlay
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),

              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                // Header
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Container(

                    IconButton(

                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
                      style: IconButton.styleFrom(padding: EdgeInsets.zero, minimumSize: const Size(32, 32)),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),

                // Input Field
                Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    const Text(
                      'Aktivitas Kebersihan',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        color: Colors.black87,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    TextField(
                      onChanged: (value) {
                        newItem = value;

                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        hintText: 'Contoh: Kuras Ember, Pel Lantai, dll...',
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),

                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),

                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
                        ),
                        filled: true,
                        fillColor: Colors.grey.shade50,
                        contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
                      ),
                      autofocus: true,
                      maxLines: 2,
                      minLines: 1,
                    ),
                  ],

                const SizedBox(height: 24),

                // Action Buttons
                Row(

                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),

                        ),
                        child: const Text(
                          'Batal',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: Colors.grey),

                      child: ElevatedButton(
                        onPressed: () {
                          if (newItem.trim().isNotEmpty) {
                            setState(() {
                              _kebersihanList.add(newItem.trim());
                            });
                            Navigator.of(context).pop();
                          }
                        },
                        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),

                        child: const Text('Tambah', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                      ),

                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  void _removeKebersihanItem(int index) {
    setState(() {
      _kebersihanList.removeAt(index);
    });
  }

  void _handleSubmit() async {
    if (_formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
      bool success;

      if (widget.area == null) {
        success = await widget.controller.addArea(
          _namaAreaController.text.trim(),
          _selectedLantai!,
          _nomorRuanganController.text.trim(),
          List.from(_kebersihanList),
          _keteranganController.text.trim(),
        );
      } else {
        success = await widget.controller.updateArea(
          widget.area!.id,
          _namaAreaController.text.trim(),
          _selectedLantai!,
          _nomorRuanganController.text.trim(),
          List.from(_kebersihanList),
          _keteranganController.text.trim(),
        );
      }

      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.of(context).pop();

        if (success) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(
              content: Text('Area berhasil ${widget.area == null ? 'ditambahkan' : 'diupdate'}!'),
              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
            ),
          );
        } else {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(
            context,
          ).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Gagal memproses area'), backgroundColor: Colors.red));
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

## ⚠️ MASALAH:

Table `daily_assignments` KOSONG karena **Admin belum generate tugas harian**.

## 🎯 PENJELASAN MASALAH:

Dari screenshot, saya lihat:
- ✅ **Areas** ada 2 (Kamar Mandi, Ruang Kerja)
- ✅ **Area Cleaning Tasks** ada 3 (Pel Lantai, Kuras Ember, Bersihkan meja)

**TAPI**, table `daily_assignments` **BELUM ADA DATANYA**!

Itu sebabnya user tidak lihat tugas di "Aktivitas Terbaru".

## 📝 SOLUSI CEPAT:

### Opsi 1: Insert Manual via SQL (PALING CEPAT)

Buka phpMyAdmin → SQL → jalankan:

```sql
-- Cek dulu ID user yang role = 'user'
SELECT id, name, role FROM users WHERE role = 'user';

-- Misalnya hasilnya: id=2, name='Super Petugas'
-- Insert assignment untuk hari ini
INSERT INTO daily_assignments (user_id, area_id, assignment_date, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(2, 1, CURDATE(), 'pending', NOW(), NOW()),  -- Kamar Mandi
(2, 2, CURDATE(), 'pending', NOW(), NOW());  -- Ruang Kerja
```

**GANTI `2` dengan user_id yang benar!**

### Opsi 2: Generate via App

1. Login sebagai **Admin**
2. Tab **Pengaturan** (paling kanan)
3. Klik **"Generate Tugas Hari Ini"**
4. ✅ Done!

---

## 🔄 KENAPA HARUS GENERATE?

Karena alur datanya seperti ini:

```
areas (✅ ADA di DB)
  └─> area_cleaning_tasks (✅ ADA di DB)
       └─> daily_assignments (❌ KOSONG!)
            └─> User Dashboard menampilkan dari sini
```

**Daily assignments** adalah **tugas harian yang di-assign ke user**. Harus di-generate setiap hari oleh admin.

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'dart:convert';
import '../../../../shared/widgets/ringkasan_widget.dart';
import '../../../../core/constants/app_styles.dart';
import '../../../../config/environment.dart';

class PengaturanContent extends StatefulWidget {
  final Map<String, int>? weeklySummary;

  const PengaturanContent({Key? key, this.weeklySummary}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<PengaturanContent> createState() => _PengaturanContentState();
}

class _PengaturanContentState extends State<PengaturanContent> {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        return Container(
          decoration: const BoxDecoration(gradient: AppColors.backgroundGradient),
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: constraints.maxHeight),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  // Ringkasan Mingguan Card
                  RingkasanWidget(
                    weeklySummary: widget.weeklySummary ?? {'total': 0, 'selesai': 0, 'menunggu': 0, 'ditolak': 0},
                  ),

                  // Pengaturan Sistem Section
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 16),
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        const Text(
                          "Pengaturan Sistem",
                          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 16, color: Colors.white),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 2),
                        const Text(
                          "Konfigurasi pengaturan untuk administrator BPS Sukabumi",

                        const SizedBox(height: 16),

                        // Jam Kerja Section
                        _buildSettingsCard(
                          title: 'Jam Kerja',

                        ),

                        const SizedBox(height: 16),

                        // Keamanan Section
                        _buildSettingsCard(
                          title: 'Keamanan',
                          children: [
                            _buildSecurityButton('Ganti Password', Colors.red),

          ),

  Widget _buildSettingsCard({required String title, required List<Widget> children}) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),

      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

        ],

  Widget _buildGenerateTaskButton() {
    return SizedBox(
      width: double.infinity,
      child: ElevatedButton.icon(
        onPressed: () => _generateDailyAssignments(),
        icon: const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome, size: 20),
        label: const Text('Generate Tugas Hari Ini', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
          foregroundColor: Colors.white,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
          elevation: 2,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _generateDailyAssignments() async {
    try {
      // Show loading
      showDialog(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: false,
        builder: (context) =>
            const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(Colors.white))),
      );

      final response = await http
          .post(
            Uri.parse('${Environment.baseUrl}/assignments/generate-daily'),
            headers: {'Accept': 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      // Close loading
      Navigator.pop(context);

      final data = json.decode(response.body);

      if (response.statusCode == 200 && data['success'] == true) {
        final created = data['data']['created'] ?? 0;
        final skipped = data['data']['skipped'] ?? 0;

        showDialog(
          context: context,
          builder: (BuildContext context) {
            return Dialog(
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Colors.white, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: const Color(0xFF4CAF50).withOpacity(0.1),
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      ),
                      child: const Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: Color(0xFF4CAF50), size: 48),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    const Text('Berhasil!', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    Text(
                      'Tugas harian berhasil di-generate',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.grey[600]),
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Colors.grey[100], borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
                      child: Column(
                        children: [
                          Row(
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                            children: [
                              const Text('Tugas dibuat:'),
                              Text(
                                '$created',
                                style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFF4CAF50)),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Row(
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                            children: [
                              const Text('Sudah ada:'),
                              Text(
                                '$skipped',
                                style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.orange),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 20),
                    SizedBox(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      child: ElevatedButton(
                        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
                        ),
                        child: const Text(
                          'Tutup',
                          style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      } else {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(data['message'] ?? 'Gagal generate tugas'), backgroundColor: Colors.red));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Close loading if still open
      Navigator.pop(context);

      ScaffoldMessenger.of(
        context,
      ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Error: ${e.toString()}'), backgroundColor: Colors.red));
    }
  }

  Widget _buildTimeSelector(String label, String startTime, String endTime) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(label, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                  children: [
                    Text(startTime, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14)),
                    const Icon(Icons.access_time, size: 20, color: Colors.grey),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 16),
            Expanded(
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                  children: [
                    Text(endTime, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14)),
                    const Icon(Icons.access_time, size: 20, color: Colors.grey),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

    return OutlinedButton.icon(
      onPressed: () {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('$label - Coming Soon'), backgroundColor: color));
      },
      icon: Icon(icon, color: color, size: 20),
      label: Text(label, style: TextStyle(color: color, fontSize: 12)),
      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
        side: BorderSide(color: color),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSecurityButton(String label, Color color) {
    return SizedBox(
      width: double.infinity,
      child: OutlinedButton(
        onPressed: () {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(
            context,
          ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('$label - Coming Soon'), backgroundColor: color));
        },
        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
          side: BorderSide(color: color),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
        ),
        child: Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(color: color, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLogoutButton() {
    return SizedBox(
      width: double.infinity,
      child: OutlinedButton(
        onPressed: () => _showLogoutConfirmation(),
        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
          side: const BorderSide(color: Colors.red),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
        ),
        child: const Text(
          'Logout',
          style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showLogoutConfirmation() {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext context) {
        return Dialog(
          backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.white,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              boxShadow: [
                BoxShadow(color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.15), blurRadius: 15, offset: const Offset(0, 5)),
              ],
            ),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                // Icon
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.1), shape: BoxShape.circle),
                  child: const Icon(Icons.logout, color: Colors.red, size: 32),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                // Title
                const Text(
                  'Konfirmasi Logout',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.black87),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                // Content
                const Text(
                  'Apakah Anda yakin ingin keluar?',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.black54),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),
                // Buttons
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: OutlinedButton(
                        onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                          side: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
                        ),
                        child: const Text(
                          'Batal',
                          style: TextStyle(color: Colors.black87, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    Expanded(
                      child: ElevatedButton(
                        onPressed: () async {
                          Navigator.of(context).pop();
                          await _performLogout();
                        },
                        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
                          foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                        ),
                        child: const Text('Logout', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _performLogout() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.clear();

      // Navigate to login and clear all previous routes
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    } catch (e) {
      print('Logout error: ${e.toString()}');
      // Still navigate even if there's an error clearing prefs
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    }
  }
}

        onPressed: () => _showLogoutConfirmation(),
        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
          side: const BorderSide(color: Colors.red),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
        ),
        child: const Text(
          'Logout',
          style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showLogoutConfirmation() {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext context) {
        return Dialog(
          backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.white,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              boxShadow: [
                BoxShadow(color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.15), blurRadius: 15, offset: const Offset(0, 5)),
              ],
            ),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                // Icon
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.1), shape: BoxShape.circle),
                  child: const Icon(Icons.logout, color: Colors.red, size: 32),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                // Title
                const Text(
                  'Konfirmasi Logout',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.black87),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                // Content
                const Text(
                  'Apakah Anda yakin ingin keluar?',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.black54),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),
                // Buttons
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: OutlinedButton(
                        onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                          side: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
                        ),
                        child: const Text(
                          'Batal',
                          style: TextStyle(color: Colors.black87, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    Expanded(
                      child: ElevatedButton(
                        onPressed: () async {
                          Navigator.of(context).pop();
                          await _performLogout();
                        },
                        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
                          foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                        ),
                        child: const Text('Logout', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _performLogout() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.clear();

      // Navigate to login and clear all previous routes
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    } catch (e) {
      print('Logout error: ${e.toString()}');
      // Still navigate even if there's an error clearing prefs
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    }
  }
}
