```dart
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome, size: 18),
                      label: const Text('Generate', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF2196F3),
                        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
                        elevation: 2,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    // Tombol Tambah Area
                    FloatingActionButton(
                      onPressed: () => _showAddAreaDialog(context, controller),
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
                      mini: true,
                      child: const Icon(Icons.add, color: Colors.white),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // List Area
            Obx(() {
              if (controller.isLoading.value) {
                return const Center(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(20),
                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(),
                  ),
                );
              }

              final areas = controller.filteredAreas;

              if (areas.isEmpty) {
                return const Center(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(20),
                    child: Text(
                      'Tidak ada area ditemukan',
                      style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              }

              return Column(
                children: areas
                    .map((area) => _buildAreaCard(context, area, controller))
                    .toList(),
              );
            }),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAreaCard(
    BuildContext context,
    Area area,
    AreaController controller,
  ) {
    return Container(

          ),
        ],
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade100),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          // Area Info
          Expanded(

  }

    showDialog(

  void _generateDailyAssignments(BuildContext context) async {
    try {
      // Show loading
      showDialog(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: false,
        builder: (context) => const Center(
          child: CircularProgressIndicator(
            valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(Color(0xFF2196F3)),
          ),
        ),
      );

      final response = await http
          .post(
            Uri.parse('${Environment.baseUrl}/assignments/generate-daily'),
            headers: {'Accept': 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      // Close loading
      if (context.mounted) Navigator.pop(context);

      final data = json.decode(response.body);

      if (response.statusCode == 200 && data['success'] == true) {
        final created = data['data']['created'] ?? 0;
        final skipped = data['data']['skipped'] ?? 0;

        if (context.mounted) {
          showDialog(
            context: context,
            builder: (BuildContext dialogContext) {
              return Dialog(
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                  ),
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: const Color(0xFF4CAF50).withOpacity(0.1),
                          shape: BoxShape.circle,
                        ),
                        child: const Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: Color(0xFF4CAF50), size: 48),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      const Text('Berhasil!', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      Text(
                        'Tugas harian berhasil di-generate',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.grey[600]),
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Colors.grey[100],
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                        ),
                        child: Column(
                          children: [
                            Row(
                              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                              children: [
                                const Text('Tugas dibuat:'),
                                Text(
                                  '$created',
                                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFF4CAF50)),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 4),
                            Row(
                              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                              children: [
                                const Text('Sudah ada:'),
                                Text(
                                  '$skipped',
                                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.orange),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 20),
                      SizedBox(
                        width: double.infinity,
                        child: ElevatedButton(
                          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
                          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
                          ),
                          child: const Text(
                            'Tutup',
                            style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              );
            },
          );
        }
      } else {
        if (context.mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(
              content: Text(data['message'] ?? 'Gagal generate tugas'),
              backgroundColor: Colors.red,
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Close loading if still open
      if (context.mounted) Navigator.pop(context);

      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('Error: ${e.toString()}'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
  Widget _buildAssignmentCard(dynamic assignment) {
    Color statusColor;
    Color statusBgColor;
    String statusText;

    switch (assignment.status) {
      case 'pending':
        statusColor = Colors.orange[700]!;
        statusBgColor = Colors.orange[100]!;
        statusText = 'Belum Lapor';
        break;
      case 'completed':
        statusColor = Colors.green[700]!;
        statusBgColor = Colors.green[100]!;
        statusText = 'Disetujui';
        break;
      case 'missed':
        statusColor = Colors.red[700]!;
        statusBgColor = Colors.red[100]!;
        statusText = 'Ditolak';
        break;
      default:
        statusColor = Colors.blue[700]!;
        statusBgColor = Colors.blue[100]!;
        statusText = 'Belum Lapor';
    }

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.grey[50],
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey[200]!, width: 1),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            width: 44,
            height: 44,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              gradient: LinearGradient(
                begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                colors: [statusColor.withOpacity(0.2), statusColor.withOpacity(0.1)],
              ),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: Icon(Icons.location_on, color: statusColor, size: 22),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 16),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  assignment.areaName,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: Colors.black87),

                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Text(

                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.grey[600], height: 1.3),
                  maxLines: 2,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,

              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: statusBgColor,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),

            ),
            child: Text(
              statusText,
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: statusColor),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
```

### **TASK 3: Generate count - Analisis**

Sebenarnya backend sudah benar. Angka "6" muncul karena:
- Ada **2 user** dengan role `'user'`
- Ada **3 area**
- Formula: 2 user × 3 area = **6 assignments**

Saat generate kedua kali: "Tugas dibuat: 0, Sudah ada: 6" artinya 6 tugas sudah pernah di-generate sebelumnya.

Saya akan lanjut ke **TASK 4: Ubah password tanpa password lama**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class UserController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display a listing of users.
     */
    public function index(): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $users = User::orderBy('created_at', 'desc')->get();
            
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Users retrieved successfully',
                'data' => $users
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to retrieve users',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created user.
     */
    public function store(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
                'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
                'username' => 'required|string|max:50|unique:users',
                'phone' => 'required|string|max:20',
                'password' => 'required|string|min:6',
                'role' => 'required|in:admin,user',
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Validation failed',
                    'errors' => $validator->errors()
                ], 422);
            }

            $user = User::create([
                'name' => $request->name,
                'username' => $request->username,
                'phone' => $request->phone,
                'password' => Hash::make($request->password),
                'role' => $request->role,
            ]);

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'User created successfully',
                'data' => $user
            ], 201);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to create user',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Display the specified user.
     */
    public function show(string $id): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $user = User::findOrFail($id);
            
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'User retrieved successfully',
                'data' => $user
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'User not found',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 404);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Update the specified user.
     */
    public function update(Request $request, string $id): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $user = User::findOrFail($id);
            
            $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
                'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
                'username' => [
                    'required',
                    'string',
                    'max:50',
                    Rule::unique('users')->ignore($user->id)
                ],
                'phone' => 'required|string|max:20',
                'password' => 'nullable|string|min:6',
                'role' => 'required|in:admin,user',
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Validation failed',
                    'errors' => $validator->errors()
                ], 422);
            }

            $updateData = [
                'name' => $request->name,
                'username' => $request->username,
                'phone' => $request->phone,
                'role' => $request->role,
            ];

            // Only update password if provided
            if ($request->filled('password')) {
                $updateData['password'] = Hash::make($request->password);
            }

            $user->update($updateData);

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'User updated successfully',
                'data' => $user->fresh()
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to update user',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Change user password (without requiring old password - for forgot password scenario).
     */
    public function changePassword(Request $request, string $id): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $user = User::findOrFail($id);
            
            $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
                'new_password' => 'required|string|min:6',
                'confirm_password' => 'required|string|same:new_password',
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Validation failed',
                    'errors' => $validator->errors()
                ], 422);
            }

            // Update password directly (no old password check - for forgot password)
            $user->update([
                'password' => Hash::make($request->new_password)
            ]);

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Password berhasil diubah'
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to change password',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Remove the specified user.
     */
    public function destroy(string $id): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $user = User::findOrFail($id);
            
            // Prevent deleting the last admin
            if ($user->role === 'admin') {
                $adminCount = User::where('role', 'admin')->count();
                if ($adminCount <= 1) {
                    return response()->json([
                        'success' => false,
                        'message' => 'Cannot delete the last admin user'
                    ], 422);
                }
            }
            
            $user->delete();

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'User deleted successfully'
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to delete user',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }
}
```

```dart
    required IconData icon,

        labelText: label,
        prefixIcon: Icon(icon, size: 20),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),

        filled: true,
        fillColor: Colors.grey[50],

  void _changePassword(BuildContext context) async {
    // Validasi input
    if (oldPasswordController.text.isEmpty ||
        newPasswordController.text.isEmpty ||
        confirmPasswordController.text.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Semua field harus diisi', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text != confirmPasswordController.text) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Konfirmasi password tidak sama', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text.length < 6) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Password baru minimal 6 karakter', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (userId.value.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'User ID tidak ditemukan', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    try {
      isLoading.value = true;

      // Panggil API change password menggunakan Environment
      final response = await http
          .put(
            Uri.parse('${Environment.baseUrl.replaceAll('/api', '')}/api/users/${userId.value}/change-password'),
            headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json'},
            body: json.encode({
              'old_password': oldPasswordController.text,
              'new_password': newPasswordController.text,
              'confirm_password': confirmPasswordController.text,
            }),
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      final responseData = json.decode(response.body);

      if (response.statusCode == 200 && responseData['success'] == true) {
        // Tutup dialog
        Navigator.of(context).pop();

        // Clear form
        oldPasswordController.clear();
        newPasswordController.clear();
        confirmPasswordController.clear();

        // Tampilkan pesan sukses
        Get.snackbar(
          'Sukses',
          responseData['message'] ?? 'Password berhasil diubah',
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
          colorText: Colors.white,
        );
      } else {
        // Tampilkan error dari server
        String errorMessage = 'Gagal mengubah password';
        if (responseData['message'] != null) {
          errorMessage = responseData['message'];
        } else if (responseData['errors'] != null) {
          final errors = responseData['errors'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
          errorMessage = errors.values.first[0];
        }

        Get.snackbar('Error', errorMessage, backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Terjadi kesalahan: ${e.toString()}', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> performLogout() async {
    try {
      // Clear home data saat logout
      if (Get.isRegistered<HomeController>()) {
        Get.find<HomeController>().clearData();
      }

      // Use AuthHelper untuk logout yang lebih robust
      if (Get.context != null) {
        await AuthHelper.logout(Get.context!);
      } else {
        // Fallback jika context tidak tersedia
        await AuthHelper.clearUserData();
        Get.offAllNamed('/login');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Logout error: ${e.toString()}');
      // Still navigate even if there's an error
      await AuthHelper.clearUserData();
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    }
  }

  Future<void> refreshData() async {
    await loadUserData();
  }
}
```

```dart
  Widget _buildInfoRow(String label, String value, IconData icon) {
    return Row(
      children: [
        Icon(icon, size: 20, color: Colors.grey[600]),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        Expanded(
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(
                label,
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.grey[600], fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 2),
              Text(
                value,
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.black87, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPasswordField({
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required String label,
    required IconData icon,
  }) {
    return TextFormField(
      controller: controller,
      obscureText: true,
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        prefixIcon: Icon(icon, size: 20),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF9C27B0)),
        ),
        filled: true,
        fillColor: Colors.grey[50],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _changePassword(BuildContext context) async {
    // Validasi input
    if (oldPasswordController.text.isEmpty ||
        newPasswordController.text.isEmpty ||
        confirmPasswordController.text.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Semua field harus diisi', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text != confirmPasswordController.text) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Konfirmasi password tidak sama', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text.length < 6) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Password baru minimal 6 karakter', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (userId.value.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'User ID tidak ditemukan', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    try {
      isLoading.value = true;

      // Panggil API change password menggunakan Environment
      final response = await http
          .put(
            Uri.parse('${Environment.baseUrl.replaceAll('/api', '')}/api/users/${userId.value}/change-password'),
            headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json'},
            body: json.encode({
              'old_password': oldPasswordController.text,
              'new_password': newPasswordController.text,
              'confirm_password': confirmPasswordController.text,
            }),
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      final responseData = json.decode(response.body);

      if (response.statusCode == 200 && responseData['success'] == true) {
        // Tutup dialog
        Navigator.of(context).pop();

        // Clear form
        oldPasswordController.clear();
        newPasswordController.clear();
        confirmPasswordController.clear();

        // Tampilkan pesan sukses
        Get.snackbar(
          'Sukses',
          responseData['message'] ?? 'Password berhasil diubah',
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
          colorText: Colors.white,
        );
      } else {
        // Tampilkan error dari server
        String errorMessage = 'Gagal mengubah password';
        if (responseData['message'] != null) {
          errorMessage = responseData['message'];
        } else if (responseData['errors'] != null) {
          final errors = responseData['errors'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
          errorMessage = errors.values.first[0];
        }

        Get.snackbar('Error', errorMessage, backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Terjadi kesalahan: ${e.toString()}', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> performLogout() async {
    try {
      // Clear home data saat logout
      if (Get.isRegistered<HomeController>()) {
        Get.find<HomeController>().clearData();
      }

      // Use AuthHelper untuk logout yang lebih robust
      if (Get.context != null) {
        await AuthHelper.logout(Get.context!);
      } else {
        // Fallback jika context tidak tersedia
        await AuthHelper.clearUserData();
        Get.offAllNamed('/login');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Logout error: ${e.toString()}');
      // Still navigate even if there's an error
      await AuthHelper.clearUserData();
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    }
  }

  Future<void> refreshData() async {
    await loadUserData();
  }
}
```

```dart
  Future<void> loadUserData() async {
    try {
      isLoading.value = true;
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final name = prefs.getString('user_name');
      final phone = prefs.getString('user_phone');
      final id = prefs.getInt('user_id');

      if (name != null && name.isNotEmpty) {
        userName.value = name;
      }
      if (phone != null && phone.isNotEmpty) {
        userPhone.value = phone;
      }
      if (id != null) {
        userId.value = id.toString();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error loading user data: $e');
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  Widget _buildPasswordField({
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required String label,
    required IconData icon,
  }) {
    return TextFormField(
      controller: controller,
      obscureText: true,
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        prefixIcon: Icon(icon, size: 20),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF9C27B0)),
        ),
        filled: true,
        fillColor: Colors.grey[50],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _changePassword(BuildContext context) async {
    // Validasi input
    if (oldPasswordController.text.isEmpty ||
        newPasswordController.text.isEmpty ||
        confirmPasswordController.text.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Semua field harus diisi', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text != confirmPasswordController.text) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Konfirmasi password tidak sama', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text.length < 6) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Password baru minimal 6 karakter', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (userId.value.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'User ID tidak ditemukan', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    try {
      isLoading.value = true;

      // Panggil API change password menggunakan Environment
      final response = await http
          .put(
            Uri.parse('${Environment.baseUrl.replaceAll('/api', '')}/api/users/${userId.value}/change-password'),
            headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json'},
            body: json.encode({
              'old_password': oldPasswordController.text,
              'new_password': newPasswordController.text,
              'confirm_password': confirmPasswordController.text,
            }),
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      final responseData = json.decode(response.body);

      if (response.statusCode == 200 && responseData['success'] == true) {
        // Tutup dialog
        Navigator.of(context).pop();

        // Clear form
        oldPasswordController.clear();
        newPasswordController.clear();
        confirmPasswordController.clear();

        // Tampilkan pesan sukses
        Get.snackbar(
          'Sukses',
          responseData['message'] ?? 'Password berhasil diubah',
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
          colorText: Colors.white,
        );
      } else {
        // Tampilkan error dari server
        String errorMessage = 'Gagal mengubah password';
        if (responseData['message'] != null) {
          errorMessage = responseData['message'];
        } else if (responseData['errors'] != null) {
          final errors = responseData['errors'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
          errorMessage = errors.values.first[0];
        }

        Get.snackbar('Error', errorMessage, backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Terjadi kesalahan: ${e.toString()}', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> performLogout() async {
    try {
      // Clear home data saat logout
      if (Get.isRegistered<HomeController>()) {
        Get.find<HomeController>().clearData();
      }

      // Use AuthHelper untuk logout yang lebih robust
      if (Get.context != null) {
        await AuthHelper.logout(Get.context!);
      } else {
        // Fallback jika context tidak tersedia
        await AuthHelper.clearUserData();
        Get.offAllNamed('/login');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Logout error: ${e.toString()}');
      // Still navigate even if there's an error
      await AuthHelper.clearUserData();
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    }
  }

  Future<void> refreshData() async {
    await loadUserData();
  }
}
```

```dart
  Future<void> loadUserData() async {
    try {
      isLoading.value = true;
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final name = prefs.getString('user_name');
      final phone = prefs.getString('user_phone');
      final id = prefs.getInt('user_id');

      if (name != null && name.isNotEmpty) {
        userName.value = name;
      }
      if (phone != null && phone.isNotEmpty) {
        userPhone.value = phone;
      }
      if (id != null) {
        userId.value = id.toString();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error loading user data: $e');
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: label,
        prefixIcon: Icon(icon, size: 20),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF9C27B0)),
        ),
        filled: true,
        fillColor: Colors.grey[50],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _changePassword(BuildContext context) async {
    // Validasi input (no old password required)
    if (newPasswordController.text.isEmpty || confirmPasswordController.text.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Semua field harus diisi', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text != confirmPasswordController.text) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Konfirmasi password tidak sama', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (newPasswordController.text.length < 6) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Password baru minimal 6 karakter', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    if (userId.value.isEmpty) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'User ID tidak ditemukan', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      return;
    }

    try {
      isLoading.value = true;

      // Panggil API change password menggunakan Environment (no old password)
      final response = await http
          .put(
            Uri.parse('${Environment.baseUrl.replaceAll('/api', '')}/api/users/${userId.value}/change-password'),
            headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json'},
            body: json.encode({
              'new_password': newPasswordController.text,
              'confirm_password': confirmPasswordController.text,
            }),
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      final responseData = json.decode(response.body);

      if (response.statusCode == 200 && responseData['success'] == true) {
        // Tutup dialog
        Navigator.of(context).pop();

        // Clear form
        newPasswordController.clear();
        confirmPasswordController.clear();

        // Tampilkan pesan sukses
        Get.snackbar(
          'Sukses',
          responseData['message'] ?? 'Password berhasil diubah',
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
          colorText: Colors.white,
        );
      } else {
        // Tampilkan error dari server
        String errorMessage = 'Gagal mengubah password';
        if (responseData['message'] != null) {
          errorMessage = responseData['message'];
        } else if (responseData['errors'] != null) {
          final errors = responseData['errors'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
          errorMessage = errors.values.first[0];
        }

        Get.snackbar('Error', errorMessage, backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      Get.snackbar('Error', 'Terjadi kesalahan: ${e.toString()}', backgroundColor: Colors.red, colorText: Colors.white);
    } finally {
      isLoading.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> performLogout() async {
    try {
      // Clear home data saat logout
      if (Get.isRegistered<HomeController>()) {
        Get.find<HomeController>().clearData();
      }

      // Use AuthHelper untuk logout yang lebih robust
      if (Get.context != null) {
        await AuthHelper.logout(Get.context!);
      } else {
        // Fallback jika context tidak tersedia
        await AuthHelper.clearUserData();
        Get.offAllNamed('/login');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      print('Logout error: ${e.toString()}');
      // Still navigate even if there's an error
      await AuthHelper.clearUserData();
      Get.offAllNamed('/login');
    }
  }

  Future<void> refreshData() async {
    await loadUserData();
  }
}

```

```php
// SEBELUM
public function changePassword(Request $request, string $id): JsonResponse
{
    $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
        'old_password' => 'required|string', // ❌ Wajib
        'new_password' => 'required|string|min:6',
        'confirm_password' => 'required|string|same:new_password',
    ]);
    
    // Check if old password is correct
    if (!Hash::check($request->old_password, $user->password)) {
        return response()->json([
            'success' => false,
            'message' => 'Password lama tidak benar'
        ], 422);
    }
}

// SESUDAH
public function changePassword(Request $request, string $id): JsonResponse
{
    $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
        // ✅ Tidak perlu old_password
        'new_password' => 'required|string|min:6',
        'confirm_password' => 'required|string|same:new_password',
    ]);
    
    // ✅ Langsung update password (no check)
    $user->update([
        'password' => Hash::make($request->new_password)
    ]);
}
```

Ah oke, saya paham sekarang! Anda mau sistem **SHARING/COLLABORATIVE** ya! 🤝

Jadi:
- **1 area = 1 tugas bersama** (bukan 1 tugas per user)
- **Siapa yang selesai duluan**, tugas jadi selesai untuk **SEMUA user**
- Lebih efisien dan tidak bikin bingung!

Mari saya ubah sistemnya:

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\DailyAssignment;
use App\Models\Area;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class DailyAssignmentController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Get daily assignments for a user
     */
    public function getUserAssignments(Request $request, $userId): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $date = $request->get('date', now()->toDateString());
            
            $assignments = DailyAssignment::with(['area', 'report'])
                ->forUser($userId)
                ->forDate($date)
                ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')
                ->get();

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Daily assignments retrieved successfully',
                'data' => $assignments,
                'date' => $date
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to retrieve assignments',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Create daily assignments for users (Admin only)
     */
    public function createAssignments(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
                'user_ids' => 'required|array',
                'user_ids.*' => 'exists:users,id',
                'area_ids' => 'required|array', 
                'area_ids.*' => 'exists:areas,id',
                'assignment_date' => 'required|date',
                'notes' => 'nullable|string'
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Validation failed',
                    'errors' => $validator->errors()
                ], 422);
            }

            $created = [];
            $duplicates = [];

            foreach ($request->user_ids as $userId) {
                foreach ($request->area_ids as $areaId) {
                    // Check if assignment already exists
                    $existing = DailyAssignment::where('user_id', $userId)
                        ->where('area_id', $areaId)
                        ->where('assignment_date', $request->assignment_date)
                        ->first();

                    if ($existing) {
                        $duplicates[] = [
                            'user_id' => $userId,
                            'area_id' => $areaId,
                            'date' => $request->assignment_date
                        ];
                        continue;
                    }

                    $assignment = DailyAssignment::create([
                        'user_id' => $userId,
                        'area_id' => $areaId,
                        'assignment_date' => $request->assignment_date,
                        'notes' => $request->notes,
                        'status' => 'pending'
                    ]);

                    $created[] = $assignment;
                }
            }

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Assignments created successfully',
                'data' => [
                    'created' => count($created),
                    'duplicates' => count($duplicates),
                    'assignments' => $created
                ]
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to create assignments',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Auto-generate daily assignments for today (SHARED MODE - 1 area = 1 assignment)
     * All users can work on any area, whoever completes it first marks it as done for everyone
     */
    public function generateDailyAssignments(): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $today = now()->toDateString();
            
            // Get first user with role 'user' as assignment owner (shared for all users)
            $firstUser = User::where('role', 'user')->first();
            
            if (!$firstUser) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'No users found with role "user"',
                ], 404);
            }
            
            // Get all active areas
            $areas = Area::all();
            
            $created = 0;
            $skipped = 0;

            // Create 1 assignment per area (shared by all users)
            foreach ($areas as $area) {
                // Check if assignment already exists for today (for this area only)
                $existing = DailyAssignment::where('area_id', $area->id)
                    ->where('assignment_date', $today)
                    ->first();

                if ($existing) {
                    $skipped++;
                    continue;
                }

                // Create shared assignment (user_id = first user, but accessible by all)
                DailyAssignment::create([
                    'user_id' => $firstUser->id,
                    'area_id' => $area->id,
                    'assignment_date' => $today,
                    'status' => 'pending'
                ]);

                $created++;
            }

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Daily assignments generated successfully (shared mode)',
                'data' => [
                    'created' => $created,
                    'skipped' => $skipped,
                    'date' => $today,
                    'mode' => 'shared' // Indicator that assignments are shared
                ]
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to generate daily assignments',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Update assignment status when report is submitted
     */
    public function updateAssignmentStatus(Request $request, $assignmentId): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $assignment = DailyAssignment::findOrFail($assignmentId);
            
            $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
                'status' => 'required|in:pending,completed,missed',
                'report_id' => 'nullable|exists:reports,id'
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Validation failed',
                    'errors' => $validator->errors()
                ], 422);
            }

            $assignment->update([
                'status' => $request->status,
                'report_id' => $request->report_id
            ]);

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Assignment status updated successfully',
                'data' => $assignment->load(['area', 'report'])
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to update assignment status',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Mark overdue assignments as missed (run daily via scheduler)
     */
    public function markOverdueAsMissed(): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $yesterday = now()->subDay()->toDateString();
            
            $overdueCount = DailyAssignment::where('assignment_date', '<', now()->toDateString())
                ->where('status', 'pending')
                ->update(['status' => 'missed']);

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Overdue assignments marked as missed',
                'data' => ['marked_missed' => $overdueCount]
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to mark overdue assignments',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get weekly report data for PDF export
     */
    public function getWeeklyReportData(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
                'year' => 'required|integer|min:2020|max:2030',
                'month' => 'required|integer|min:1|max:12',
                'week' => 'required|integer|min:1|max:4'
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Validation failed',
                    'errors' => $validator->errors()
                ], 422);
            }

            // Calculate week dates
            $year = $request->year;
            $month = $request->month;
            $week = $request->week;
            
            $startOfMonth = Carbon::create($year, $month, 1);
            $startOfWeek = $startOfMonth->copy()->addWeeks($week - 1)->startOfWeek();
            $endOfWeek = $startOfWeek->copy()->endOfWeek();
            
            // Ensure we don't go beyond the month
            if ($endOfWeek->month > $month) {
                $endOfWeek = $startOfMonth->copy()->endOfMonth();
            }

            // Get assignments for the week
            $assignments = DailyAssignment::with(['user', 'area', 'report'])
                ->whereBetween('assignment_date', [$startOfWeek, $endOfWeek])
                ->orderBy('assignment_date', 'asc')
                ->get();

            // Group by user
            $reportData = $assignments->groupBy('user.name')->map(function ($userAssignments) {
                return [
                    'user' => $userAssignments->first()->user,
                    'assignments' => $userAssignments->groupBy('assignment_date')->map(function ($dateAssignments) {
                        return $dateAssignments->map(function ($assignment) {
                            return [
                                'area' => $assignment->area,
                                'status' => $assignment->status,
                                'report' => $assignment->report,
                                'completed_at' => $assignment->report?->created_at
                            ];
                        });
                    })
                ];
            });

            // Calculate summary
            $summary = [
                'total_assignments' => $assignments->count(),
                'completed' => $assignments->where('status', 'completed')->count(),
                'pending' => $assignments->where('status', 'pending')->count(),
                'missed' => $assignments->where('status', 'missed')->count(),
                'completion_rate' => $assignments->count() > 0 
                    ? round(($assignments->where('status', 'completed')->count() / $assignments->count()) * 100, 1) 
                    : 0
            ];

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Weekly report data retrieved successfully',
                'data' => [
                    'period' => [
                        'year' => $year,
                        'month' => $month,
                        'week' => $week,
                        'start_date' => $startOfWeek->toDateString(),
                        'end_date' => $endOfWeek->toDateString(),
                        'period_text' => "Minggu ke-{$week}, " . $startOfWeek->format('F Y')
                    ],
                    'summary' => $summary,
                    'assignments' => $assignments,
                    'report_data' => $reportData
                ]
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to retrieve weekly report data',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }
}
```

Sekarang update `ReportController` agar saat submit laporan, assignment di-update berdasarkan area saja (bukan user spesifik):

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Report;
use App\Models\ReportPhoto;
use App\Models\ReportTask;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class ReportController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Store a newly created report with photos
     */
    public function store(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
                'area_id' => 'required|exists:areas,id',
                'user_id' => 'required|exists:users,id',
                'area_name' => 'required|string',
                'lantai' => 'required|string',
                'nomor_ruangan' => 'required|string',
                'completed_task_ids' => 'required|json',
                'catatan_pembersihan' => 'required|string',
                'photos' => 'required|array|min:1|max:5',
                'photos.*' => 'image|mimes:jpeg,jpg,png|max:5120', // Max 5MB per file
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Validation failed',
                    'errors' => $validator->errors()
                ], 422);
            }

            DB::beginTransaction();

            // Create report
            $report = Report::create([
                'area_id' => $request->area_id,
                'user_id' => $request->user_id,
                'title' => "Laporan Pembersihan - {$request->area_name}",
                'description' => $request->catatan_pembersihan,
                'status' => 'pending',
                'submission_date' => now(), // Save full datetime
            ]);

            // Save completed tasks with cleaning_task_id reference
            $completedTaskIds = json_decode($request->completed_task_ids, true);
            if (is_array($completedTaskIds)) {
                foreach ($completedTaskIds as $taskId) {
                    // Get actual task from area_cleaning_tasks table
                    $areaTask = \App\Models\AreaCleaningTask::find($taskId);
                    
                    if ($areaTask) {
                        ReportTask::create([
                            'report_id' => $report->id,
                            'cleaning_task_id' => $areaTask->id, // Save the cleaning_task_id
                            'task_name' => $areaTask->task_name, // Also save task name for convenience
                            'is_completed' => true,
                            'notes' => null, // Notes can be added later if needed
                        ]);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Upload and save photos
            if ($request->hasFile('photos')) {
                $photos = $request->file('photos');
                foreach ($photos as $index => $photo) {
                    // Generate unique filename
                    $filename = time() . '_' . $index . '_' . uniqid() . '.' . $photo->getClientOriginalExtension();
                    
                    // Store in public/storage/report_photos
                    $path = $photo->storeAs('report_photos', $filename, 'public');

                    // Save photo record
                    ReportPhoto::create([
                        'report_id' => $report->id,
                        'photo_path' => $path,
                        'original_name' => $photo->getClientOriginalName(),
                        'file_size' => $photo->getSize(),
                        'mime_type' => $photo->getMimeType(),
                        'order' => $index,
                    ]);
                }
            }

            // Update daily assignment status to 'completed' (SHARED MODE - by area only, not user)
            // Whoever submits report first completes the assignment for ALL users
            $today = now()->toDateString();
            $assignment = \App\Models\DailyAssignment::where('area_id', $request->area_id)
                ->where('assignment_date', $today)
                ->where('status', 'pending')
                ->first();

            if ($assignment) {
                $assignment->update([
                    'status' => 'completed',
                    'report_id' => $report->id,
                ]);

                if (config('app.debug')) {
                    \Log::info('Assignment updated to completed (shared mode)', [
                        'assignment_id' => $assignment->id,
                        'area_id' => $request->area_id,
                        'completed_by_user_id' => $request->user_id,
                        'report_id' => $report->id,
                    ]);
                }
            }

            DB::commit();

            // Load relationships
            $report->load(['photos', 'tasks', 'area', 'user']);

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Laporan berhasil dikirim',
                'data' => [
                    'id' => $report->id,
                    'area_id' => $request->area_id,
                    'area_name' => $request->area_name,
                    'lantai' => $request->lantai,
                    'nomor_ruangan' => $request->nomor_ruangan,
                    'status' => $report->status,
                    'submission_date' => $report->submission_date,
                    'photos_count' => $report->photos->count(),
                    'tasks_count' => $report->tasks->count(),
                    'assignment_updated' => $assignment ? true : false,
                ]
            ], 201);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            DB::rollBack();
            
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to create report',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get all reports
     */
    public function index(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $query = Report::with(['photos', 'tasks', 'area', 'user']);

            // Filter by status
            if ($request->has('status')) {
                $query->where('status', $request->status);
            }

            // Filter by user (for petugas to see their own reports)
            if ($request->has('user_id')) {
                $query->where('user_id', $request->user_id);
            }

            $reports = $query->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')->get();

            // Transform response for frontend
            $formattedReports = $reports->map(function ($report) {
                return [
                    'id' => $report->id,
                    'title' => $report->title,
                    'description' => $report->description,
                    'status' => $report->status,
                    'submission_date' => $report->submission_date,
                    'user' => [
                        'id' => $report->user->id,
                        'name' => $report->user->name,
                        'username' => $report->user->username,
                    ],
                    'area' => [
                        'id' => $report->area->id,
                        'name' => $report->area->name,
                        'lantai' => $report->area->lantai,
                        'nomor_ruangan' => $report->area->nomor_ruangan,
                    ],
                    'tasks' => $report->tasks->map(function ($task) {
                        return [
                            'id' => $task->id,
                            'task_name' => $task->task_name,
                            'is_completed' => $task->is_completed,
                            'notes' => $task->notes,
                        ];
                    }),
                    'photos' => $report->photos->map(function ($photo) {
                        // Generate full URL manually to avoid file:// protocol issue
                        $baseUrl = request()->getSchemeAndHttpHost(); // Get http://10.0.2.2:8000
                        return [
                            'id' => $photo->id,
                            'photo_path' => $baseUrl . '/storage/' . $photo->photo_path,
                        ];
                    }),
                    'admin_notes' => $report->admin_notes,
                    'reviewed_at' => $report->reviewed_at,
                ];
            });

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Reports retrieved successfully',
                'data' => $formattedReports
            ]);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to retrieve reports',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get single report
     */
    public function show(string $id): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $report = Report::with(['photos', 'tasks', 'area', 'user', 'reviewer'])
                ->findOrFail($id);

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Report retrieved successfully',
                'data' => $report
            ]);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Report not found',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 404);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Update report status (for admin)
     */
    public function updateStatus(Request $request, string $id): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
                'status' => 'required|in:pending,approved,rejected',
                'admin_notes' => 'nullable|string',
                'rating' => 'nullable|integer|min:1|max:5',
                'reviewed_by' => 'required|exists:users,id',
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Validation failed',
                    'errors' => $validator->errors()
                ], 422);
            }

            $report = Report::findOrFail($id);
            
            $report->update([
                'status' => $request->status,
                'admin_notes' => $request->admin_notes,
                'rating' => $request->rating,
                'reviewed_by' => $request->reviewed_by,
                'reviewed_at' => now(),
            ]);

            // Load relationships for complete response
            $report->load(['photos', 'tasks', 'area', 'user', 'reviewer']);

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Report status updated successfully',
                'data' => $report
            ]);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to update report status',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }
}

```

## 📝 PERUBAHAN KODE

### 1. ✅ Backend: `DailyAssignmentController.php`

#### **A. Generate Assignments (Shared Mode)**

**File**: `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/DailyAssignmentController.php`

**Perubahan**:
```php
// ❌ SEBELUM (Individual - loop semua user)
public function generateDailyAssignments(): JsonResponse
{
    $users = User::where('role', 'user')->get();
    $areas = Area::all();
    
    foreach ($users as $user) {        // Loop 2 user
        foreach ($areas as $area) {     // Loop 2 area
            // Create 4 assignments (2×2)
            DailyAssignment::create([
                'user_id' => $user->id,
                'area_id' => $area->id,
                'assignment_date' => $today,
                'status' => 'pending'
            ]);
        }
    }
    // Result: 4 assignments
}

// ✅ SESUDAH (Shared - 1 area = 1 assignment)
public function generateDailyAssignments(): JsonResponse
{
    $firstUser = User::where('role', 'user')->first();
    $areas = Area::all();
    
    // Create 1 assignment per area (shared)
    foreach ($areas as $area) {         // Loop 2 area saja
        $existing = DailyAssignment::where('area_id', $area->id)
            ->where('assignment_date', $today)
            ->first();

        if (!$existing) {
            // Create shared assignment
            DailyAssignment::create([
                'user_id' => $firstUser->id,  // Dummy user (shared for all)
                'area_id' => $area->id,
                'assignment_date' => $today,
                'status' => 'pending'
            ]);
        }
    }
    // Result: 2 assignments (1 per area)
}
```

**Hasil**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Daily assignments generated successfully (shared mode)",
  "data": {
    "created": 2,        // ✅ Hanya 2! (bukan 4)
    "skipped": 0,
    "date": "2025-10-16",
    "mode": "shared"     // ✅ Indicator
  }
}
```

#### **B. Get User Assignments (Shared Mode)**

```php
// ❌ SEBELUM (Filter by user_id)
public function getUserAssignments(Request $request, $userId): JsonResponse
{
    $assignments = DailyAssignment::with(['area', 'report'])
        ->forUser($userId)              // ❌ Filter by user
        ->forDate($date)
        ->get();
    
    // User A lihat 2 assignments
    // User B lihat 2 assignments (DUPLIKAT)
}

// ✅ SESUDAH (Semua user lihat semua area)
public function getUserAssignments(Request $request, $userId): JsonResponse
{
    // SHARED MODE: Get all assignments for the date
    $assignments = DailyAssignment::with(['area', 'report'])
        ->forDate($date)                // ✅ Tidak filter by user
        ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')
        ->get();
    
    // Semua user lihat 2 assignments yang SAMA
}
```

### 2. ✅ Backend: `ReportController.php`

#### **Update Assignment Status (Shared Mode)**

**File**: `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/ReportController.php`

**Perubahan**:
```php
// ❌ SEBELUM (Update by user_id + area_id)
$assignment = DailyAssignment::where('user_id', $request->user_id)  // ❌ Specific user
    ->where('area_id', $request->area_id)
    ->where('assignment_date', $today)
    ->where('status', 'pending')
    ->first();

if ($assignment) {
    $assignment->update([
        'status' => 'completed',
        'report_id' => $report->id,
    ]);
}
// Result: Hanya assignment user A yang completed

// ✅ SESUDAH (Update by area_id saja)
$assignment = DailyAssignment::where('area_id', $request->area_id)  // ✅ By area only
    ->where('assignment_date', $today)
    ->where('status', 'pending')
    ->first();

if ($assignment) {
    $assignment->update([
        'status' => 'completed',
        'report_id' => $report->id,
    ]);
    
    \Log::info('Assignment updated (shared mode)', [
        'completed_by_user_id' => $request->user_id,  // Track siapa yang selesaikan
    ]);
}
// Result: Assignment completed untuk SEMUA user!
```

## 📝 CATATAN PENTING

### **User ID di Assignment**

Assignment tetap punya `user_id` (untuk database structure), tapi:
- Diisi dengan **user pertama** saat generate
- **TIDAK digunakan** untuk filtering
- Hanya sebagai "owner" teknis

### **Tracking Siapa yang Selesaikan**

Lihat di **report**:
```sql
SELECT 
    a.area_id,
    a.status,
    r.user_id as completed_by,
    u.name as completed_by_name
FROM daily_assignments a
LEFT JOIN reports r ON a.report_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id
WHERE a.assignment_date = CURDATE();
```
