## 12. Update DailyAssignmentController untuk Trigger Notifikasi

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\DailyAssignment;
use App\Models\Area;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class DailyAssignmentController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Get daily assignments for a user (SHARED MODE - all users see all areas for the day)
     */
    public function getUserAssignments(Request $request, $userId): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $date = $request->get('date', now()->toDateString());
            
            // SHARED MODE: Get all assignments for the date (not filtered by user_id)
            // All users can see and work on all areas
            $assignments = DailyAssignment::with(['area', 'report'])
                ->forDate($date)
                ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')
                ->get();

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Daily assignments retrieved successfully (shared mode)',
                'data' => $assignments,
                'date' => $date,
                'mode' => 'shared' // Indicator that assignments are shared
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to retrieve assignments',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Create daily assignments for users (Admin only)
     */
    public function createAssignments(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
                'user_ids' => 'required|array',
                'user_ids.*' => 'exists:users,id',
                'area_ids' => 'required|array', 
                'area_ids.*' => 'exists:areas,id',
                'assignment_date' => 'required|date',
                'notes' => 'nullable|string'
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Validation failed',
                    'errors' => $validator->errors()
                ], 422);
            }

            $created = [];
            $duplicates = [];

            foreach ($request->user_ids as $userId) {
                foreach ($request->area_ids as $areaId) {
                    // Check if assignment already exists
                    $existing = DailyAssignment::where('user_id', $userId)
                        ->where('area_id', $areaId)
                        ->where('assignment_date', $request->assignment_date)
                        ->first();

                    if ($existing) {
                        $duplicates[] = [
                            'user_id' => $userId,
                            'area_id' => $areaId,
                            'date' => $request->assignment_date
                        ];
                        continue;
                    }

                    $assignment = DailyAssignment::create([
                        'user_id' => $userId,
                        'area_id' => $areaId,
                        'assignment_date' => $request->assignment_date,
                        'notes' => $request->notes,
                        'status' => 'pending'
                    ]);

                    $created[] = $assignment;
                }
            }

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Assignments created successfully',
                'data' => [
                    'created' => count($created),
                    'duplicates' => count($duplicates),
                    'assignments' => $created
                ]
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to create assignments',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Auto-generate daily assignments for today (SHARED MODE - 1 area = 1 assignment)
     * All users can work on any area, whoever completes it first marks it as done for everyone
     */
    public function generateDailyAssignments(): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $today = now()->toDateString();
            
            // Get first user with role 'user' as assignment owner (shared for all users)
            $firstUser = User::where('role', 'user')->first();
            
            if (!$firstUser) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'No users found with role "user"',
                ], 404);
            }
            
            // Get all active areas
            $areas = Area::all();
            
            $created = 0;
            $skipped = 0;

            // Create 1 assignment per area (shared by all users)
            foreach ($areas as $area) {
                // Check if assignment already exists for today (for this area only)
                $existing = DailyAssignment::where('area_id', $area->id)
                    ->where('assignment_date', $today)
                    ->first();

                if ($existing) {
                    $skipped++;
                    continue;
                }

                // Create shared assignment (user_id = first user, but accessible by all)
                DailyAssignment::create([
                    'user_id' => $firstUser->id,
                    'area_id' => $area->id,
                    'assignment_date' => $today,
                    'status' => 'pending'
                ]);

                $created++;
            }

            // Send notification to all users after creating assignments
            if ($created > 0) {
                \App\Services\FCMService::sendToRole(
                    'user',
                    'Tugas Harian Baru',
                    "Ada $created tugas pembersihan baru untuk hari ini",
                    ['type' => 'new_assignment', 'count' => $created]
                );
            }

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Daily assignments generated successfully (shared mode)',
                'data' => [
                    'created' => $created,
                    'skipped' => $skipped,
                    'date' => $today,
                    'mode' => 'shared' // Indicator that assignments are shared
                ]
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to generate daily assignments',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Update assignment status when report is submitted
     */
    public function updateAssignmentStatus(Request $request, $assignmentId): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $assignment = DailyAssignment::findOrFail($assignmentId);
            
            $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
                'status' => 'required|in:pending,completed,missed',
                'report_id' => 'nullable|exists:reports,id'
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Validation failed',
                    'errors' => $validator->errors()
                ], 422);
            }

            $assignment->update([
                'status' => $request->status,
                'report_id' => $request->report_id
            ]);

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Assignment status updated successfully',
                'data' => $assignment->load(['area', 'report'])
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to update assignment status',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Mark overdue assignments as missed (run daily via scheduler)
     */
    public function markOverdueAsMissed(): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $yesterday = now()->subDay()->toDateString();
            
            $overdueCount = DailyAssignment::where('assignment_date', '<', now()->toDateString())
                ->where('status', 'pending')
                ->update(['status' => 'missed']);

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Overdue assignments marked as missed',
                'data' => ['marked_missed' => $overdueCount]
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to mark overdue assignments',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get weekly report data for PDF export
     */
    public function getWeeklyReportData(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
                'year' => 'required|integer|min:2020|max:2030',
                'month' => 'required|integer|min:1|max:12',
                'week' => 'required|integer|min:1|max:4'
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Validation failed',
                    'errors' => $validator->errors()
                ], 422);
            }

            // Calculate week dates
            $year = $request->year;
            $month = $request->month;
            $week = $request->week;
            
            $startOfMonth = Carbon::create($year, $month, 1);
            $startOfWeek = $startOfMonth->copy()->addWeeks($week - 1)->startOfWeek();
            $endOfWeek = $startOfWeek->copy()->endOfWeek();
            
            // Ensure we don't go beyond the month
            if ($endOfWeek->month > $month) {
                $endOfWeek = $startOfMonth->copy()->endOfMonth();
            }

            // Get assignments for the week
            $assignments = DailyAssignment::with(['user', 'area', 'report'])
                ->whereBetween('assignment_date', [$startOfWeek, $endOfWeek])
                ->orderBy('assignment_date', 'asc')
                ->get();

            // Group by user
            $reportData = $assignments->groupBy('user.name')->map(function ($userAssignments) {
                return [
                    'user' => $userAssignments->first()->user,
                    'assignments' => $userAssignments->groupBy('assignment_date')->map(function ($dateAssignments) {
                        return $dateAssignments->map(function ($assignment) {
                            return [
                                'area' => $assignment->area,
                                'status' => $assignment->status,
                                'report' => $assignment->report,
                                'completed_at' => $assignment->report?->created_at
                            ];
                        });
                    })
                ];
            });

            // Calculate summary
            $summary = [
                'total_assignments' => $assignments->count(),
                'completed' => $assignments->where('status', 'completed')->count(),
                'pending' => $assignments->where('status', 'pending')->count(),
                'missed' => $assignments->where('status', 'missed')->count(),
                'completion_rate' => $assignments->count() > 0 
                    ? round(($assignments->where('status', 'completed')->count() / $assignments->count()) * 100, 1) 
                    : 0
            ];

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Weekly report data retrieved successfully',
                'data' => [
                    'period' => [
                        'year' => $year,
                        'month' => $month,
                        'week' => $week,
                        'start_date' => $startOfWeek->toDateString(),
                        'end_date' => $endOfWeek->toDateString(),
                        'period_text' => "Minggu ke-{$week}, " . $startOfWeek->format('F Y')
                    ],
                    'summary' => $summary,
                    'assignments' => $assignments,
                    'report_data' => $reportData
                ]
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to retrieve weekly report data',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }
}

## 13. Update ReportController untuk Trigger Notifikasi

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Report;
use App\Models\ReportPhoto;
use App\Models\ReportTask;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class ReportController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Store a newly created report with photos
     */
    public function store(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
                'area_id' => 'required|exists:areas,id',
                'user_id' => 'required|exists:users,id',
                'area_name' => 'required|string',
                'lantai' => 'required|string',
                'nomor_ruangan' => 'required|string',
                'completed_task_ids' => 'required|json',
                'catatan_pembersihan' => 'required|string',
                'photos' => 'required|array|min:1|max:5',
                'photos.*' => 'image|mimes:jpeg,jpg,png|max:5120', // Max 5MB per file
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Validation failed',
                    'errors' => $validator->errors()
                ], 422);
            }

            DB::beginTransaction();

            // Create report
            $report = Report::create([
                'area_id' => $request->area_id,
                'user_id' => $request->user_id,
                'title' => "Laporan Pembersihan - {$request->area_name}",
                'description' => $request->catatan_pembersihan,
                'status' => 'pending',
                'submission_date' => now(), // Save full datetime
            ]);

            // Save completed tasks with cleaning_task_id reference
            $completedTaskIds = json_decode($request->completed_task_ids, true);
            if (is_array($completedTaskIds)) {
                foreach ($completedTaskIds as $taskId) {
                    // Get actual task from area_cleaning_tasks table
                    $areaTask = \App\Models\AreaCleaningTask::find($taskId);
                    
                    if ($areaTask) {
                        ReportTask::create([
                            'report_id' => $report->id,
                            'cleaning_task_id' => $areaTask->id, // Save the cleaning_task_id
                            'task_name' => $areaTask->task_name, // Also save task name for convenience
                            'is_completed' => true,
                            'notes' => null, // Notes can be added later if needed
                        ]);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Upload and save photos
            if ($request->hasFile('photos')) {
                $photos = $request->file('photos');
                foreach ($photos as $index => $photo) {
                    // Generate unique filename
                    $filename = time() . '_' . $index . '_' . uniqid() . '.' . $photo->getClientOriginalExtension();
                    
                    // Store in public/storage/report_photos
                    $path = $photo->storeAs('report_photos', $filename, 'public');

                    // Save photo record
                    ReportPhoto::create([
                        'report_id' => $report->id,
                        'photo_path' => $path,
                        'original_name' => $photo->getClientOriginalName(),
                        'file_size' => $photo->getSize(),
                        'mime_type' => $photo->getMimeType(),
                        'order' => $index,
                    ]);
                }
            }

            // Update daily assignment status to 'completed' (SHARED MODE - by area only, not user)
            // Whoever submits report first completes the assignment for ALL users
            $today = now()->toDateString();
            $assignment = \App\Models\DailyAssignment::where('area_id', $request->area_id)
                ->where('assignment_date', $today)
                ->where('status', 'pending')
                ->first();

            if ($assignment) {
                $assignment->update([
                    'status' => 'completed',
                    'report_id' => $report->id,
                ]);

                if (config('app.debug')) {
                    \Log::info('Assignment updated to completed (shared mode)', [
                        'assignment_id' => $assignment->id,
                        'area_id' => $request->area_id,
                        'completed_by_user_id' => $request->user_id,
                        'report_id' => $report->id,
                    ]);
                }
            }

            DB::commit();

            // Load relationships
            $report->load(['photos', 'tasks', 'area', 'user']);

            // Send notification to all admins
            $user = \App\Models\User::find($request->user_id);
            if ($user) {
                \App\Services\FCMService::sendToRole(
                    'admin',
                    'Laporan Baru Masuk',
                    "{$user->name} mengirim laporan pembersihan {$request->area_name}",
                    ['type' => 'new_report', 'report_id' => $report->id]
                );
            }

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Laporan berhasil dikirim',
                'data' => [
                    'id' => $report->id,
                    'area_id' => $request->area_id,
                    'area_name' => $request->area_name,
                    'lantai' => $request->lantai,
                    'nomor_ruangan' => $request->nomor_ruangan,
                    'status' => $report->status,
                    'submission_date' => $report->submission_date,
                    'photos_count' => $report->photos->count(),
                    'tasks_count' => $report->tasks->count(),
                    'assignment_updated' => $assignment ? true : false,
                ]
            ], 201);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            DB::rollBack();
            
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to create report',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get all reports
     */
    public function index(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $query = Report::with(['photos', 'tasks', 'area', 'user']);

            // Filter by status
            if ($request->has('status')) {
                $query->where('status', $request->status);
            }

            // Filter by user (for petugas to see their own reports)
            if ($request->has('user_id')) {
                $query->where('user_id', $request->user_id);
            }

            $reports = $query->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')->get();

            // Transform response for frontend
            $formattedReports = $reports->map(function ($report) {
                return [
                    'id' => $report->id,
                    'title' => $report->title,
                    'description' => $report->description,
                    'status' => $report->status,
                    'submission_date' => $report->submission_date,
                    'user' => [
                        'id' => $report->user->id,
                        'name' => $report->user->name,
                        'username' => $report->user->username,
                    ],
                    'area' => [
                        'id' => $report->area->id,
                        'name' => $report->area->name,
                        'lantai' => $report->area->lantai,
                        'nomor_ruangan' => $report->area->nomor_ruangan,
                    ],
                    'tasks' => $report->tasks->map(function ($task) {
                        return [
                            'id' => $task->id,
                            'task_name' => $task->task_name,
                            'is_completed' => $task->is_completed,
                            'notes' => $task->notes,
                        ];
                    }),
                    'photos' => $report->photos->map(function ($photo) {
                        // Generate full URL manually to avoid file:// protocol issue
                        $baseUrl = request()->getSchemeAndHttpHost(); // Get http://10.0.2.2:8000
                        return [
                            'id' => $photo->id,
                            'photo_path' => $baseUrl . '/storage/' . $photo->photo_path,
                        ];
                    }),
                    'admin_notes' => $report->admin_notes,
                    'reviewed_at' => $report->reviewed_at,
                ];
            });

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Reports retrieved successfully',
                'data' => $formattedReports
            ]);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to retrieve reports',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get single report
     */
    public function show(string $id): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $report = Report::with(['photos', 'tasks', 'area', 'user', 'reviewer'])
                ->findOrFail($id);

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Report retrieved successfully',
                'data' => $report
            ]);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Report not found',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 404);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Update report status (for admin)
     */
    public function updateStatus(Request $request, string $id): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
                'status' => 'required|in:pending,approved,rejected',
                'admin_notes' => 'nullable|string',
                'rating' => 'nullable|integer|min:1|max:5',
                'reviewed_by' => 'required|exists:users,id',
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Validation failed',
                    'errors' => $validator->errors()
                ], 422);
            }

            $report = Report::findOrFail($id);
            
            $report->update([
                'status' => $request->status,
                'admin_notes' => $request->admin_notes,
                'rating' => $request->rating,
                'reviewed_by' => $request->reviewed_by,
                'reviewed_at' => now(),
            ]);

            // Load relationships for complete response
            $report->load(['photos', 'tasks', 'area', 'user', 'reviewer']);

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Report status updated successfully',
                'data' => $report
            ]);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to update report status',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }
}

                        'report_id' => $report->id,
                        'photo_path' => $path,
                        'original_name' => $photo->getClientOriginalName(),
                        'file_size' => $photo->getSize(),
                        'mime_type' => $photo->getMimeType(),
                        'order' => $index,
                    ]);
                }
            }

            // Update daily assignment status to 'completed' (SHARED MODE - by area only, not user)
            // Whoever submits report first completes the assignment for ALL users
            $today = now()->toDateString();
            $assignment = \App\Models\DailyAssignment::where('area_id', $request->area_id)
                ->where('assignment_date', $today)
                ->where('status', 'pending')
                ->first();

            if ($assignment) {
                $assignment->update([
                    'status' => 'completed',
                    'report_id' => $report->id,
                ]);

                if (config('app.debug')) {
                    \Log::info('Assignment updated to completed (shared mode)', [
                        'assignment_id' => $assignment->id,
                        'area_id' => $request->area_id,
                        'completed_by_user_id' => $request->user_id,
                        'report_id' => $report->id,
                    ]);
                }
            }

            DB::commit();

            // Load relationships
            $report->load(['photos', 'tasks', 'area', 'user']);

            // Send notification to all admins
            $user = \App\Models\User::find($request->user_id);
            if ($user) {
                \App\Services\FCMService::sendToRole(
                    'admin',
                    'Laporan Baru Masuk',
                    "{$user->name} mengirim laporan pembersihan {$request->area_name}",
                    ['type' => 'new_report', 'report_id' => $report->id]
                );
            }

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Laporan berhasil dikirim',
                'data' => [
                    'id' => $report->id,
                    'area_id' => $request->area_id,
                    'area_name' => $request->area_name,
                    'lantai' => $request->lantai,
                    'nomor_ruangan' => $request->nomor_ruangan,
                    'status' => $report->status,
                    'submission_date' => $report->submission_date,
                    'photos_count' => $report->photos->count(),
                    'tasks_count' => $report->tasks->count(),
                    'assignment_updated' => $assignment ? true : false,
                ]
            ], 201);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            DB::rollBack();
            
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to create report',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get all reports
     */
    public function index(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $query = Report::with(['photos', 'tasks', 'area', 'user']);

            // Filter by status
            if ($request->has('status')) {
                $query->where('status', $request->status);
            }

            // Filter by user (for petugas to see their own reports)
            if ($request->has('user_id')) {
                $query->where('user_id', $request->user_id);
            }

            $reports = $query->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')->get();

            // Transform response for frontend
            $formattedReports = $reports->map(function ($report) {
                return [
                    'id' => $report->id,
                    'title' => $report->title,
                    'description' => $report->description,
                    'status' => $report->status,
                    'submission_date' => $report->submission_date,
                    'user' => [
                        'id' => $report->user->id,
                        'name' => $report->user->name,
                        'username' => $report->user->username,
                    ],
                    'area' => [
                        'id' => $report->area->id,
                        'name' => $report->area->name,
                        'lantai' => $report->area->lantai,
                        'nomor_ruangan' => $report->area->nomor_ruangan,
                    ],
                    'tasks' => $report->tasks->map(function ($task) {
                        return [
                            'id' => $task->id,
                            'task_name' => $task->task_name,
                            'is_completed' => $task->is_completed,
                            'notes' => $task->notes,
                        ];
                    }),
                    'photos' => $report->photos->map(function ($photo) {
                        // Generate full URL manually to avoid file:// protocol issue
                        $baseUrl = request()->getSchemeAndHttpHost(); // Get http://10.0.2.2:8000
                        return [
                            'id' => $photo->id,
                            'photo_path' => $baseUrl . '/storage/' . $photo->photo_path,
                        ];
                    }),
                    'admin_notes' => $report->admin_notes,
                    'reviewed_at' => $report->reviewed_at,
                ];
            });

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Reports retrieved successfully',
                'data' => $formattedReports
            ]);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to retrieve reports',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get single report
     */
    public function show(string $id): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $report = Report::with(['photos', 'tasks', 'area', 'user', 'reviewer'])
                ->findOrFail($id);

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Report retrieved successfully',
                'data' => $report
            ]);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Report not found',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 404);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Update report status (for admin)
     */
    public function updateStatus(Request $request, string $id): JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
                'status' => 'required|in:pending,approved,rejected',
                'admin_notes' => 'nullable|string',
                'rating' => 'nullable|integer|min:1|max:5',
                'reviewed_by' => 'required|exists:users,id',
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Validation failed',
                    'errors' => $validator->errors()
                ], 422);
            }

            $report = Report::findOrFail($id);
            
            $report->update([
                'status' => $request->status,
                'admin_notes' => $request->admin_notes,
                'rating' => $request->rating,
                'reviewed_by' => $request->reviewed_by,
                'reviewed_at' => now(),
            ]);

            // Load relationships for complete response
            $report->load(['photos', 'tasks', 'area', 'user', 'reviewer']);

            // Send notification to report owner
            $statusText = $request->status === 'approved' ? 'disetujui' : 'ditolak';
            if ($report->user && $report->user->fcm_token) {
                \App\Services\FCMService::sendToUser(
                    $report->user->fcm_token,
                    'Laporan ' . ucfirst($statusText),
                    "Laporan pembersihan {$report->area->name} telah $statusText oleh admin",
                    ['type' => 'report_reviewed', 'report_id' => $report->id, 'status' => $request->status]
                );
            }

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Report status updated successfully',
                'data' => $report
            ]);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to update report status',
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }
}

```

## Cara Kerja Push Notification:

### 1. **Saat App di Background/Closed:**

- User tap notifikasi → app terbuka ke halaman terkait

### 2. **Saat App di Foreground (sedang dibuka):**
- Notifikasi muncul sebagai **Snackbar** (popup di atas layar)
- Sudah saya implement di `FCMService.dart` line 36-43

### 3. **Trigger Otomatis:**
- ✅ Admin klik "Generate Tugas Harian" → Notif ke semua user
- ✅ User submit laporan → Notif ke semua admin
- ✅ Admin approve/reject laporan → Notif ke user pembuat laporan

## 📝 Notes

1. **FCM Token Refresh**: Token akan berubah jika user reinstall app. Untuk production, tambahkan listener `onTokenRefresh` di FCMService.

2. **Testing di Emulator**: Pastikan emulator menggunakan **Google Play Services**. AVD dengan Google APIs tidak cukup.

3. **Debug Notification**: Check Laravel log di `storage/logs/laravel.log` untuk melihat FCM request/response.

4. **Network**: FCM membutuhkan koneksi internet. Pastikan device/emulator terkoneksi.

5. **Android 13+**: Permission `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` akan diminta saat pertama kali login. User harus approve untuk menerima notifikasi.

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../../../data/repositories/user_repository.dart';
import '../../../data/models/user.dart';
import '../../../core/constants/app_styles.dart';
import '../../../services/fcm_service.dart';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import '../../../config/environment.dart';
import 'dart:developer' as dev;

class LoginPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const LoginPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<LoginPage> createState() => _LoginPageState();
}

class _LoginPageState extends State<LoginPage> {
  final TextEditingController _usernameController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _passwordController = TextEditingController();
  final UserRepository _userRepository = UserRepository();
  bool _isLoading = false;

  Future<void> _login() async {
    // Validasi form
    if (_usernameController.text.isEmpty || _passwordController.text.isEmpty) {
      _showSnackBar('Username dan password harus diisi');
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
    });

    try {
      final result = await _userRepository.login(
        username: _usernameController.text.trim(),
        password: _passwordController.text,
      );

      final User user = result['user'];
      final String token = result['token'];

      // Save user data to SharedPreferences
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setInt('user_id', user.id);
      await prefs.setString('user_name', user.name);
      await prefs.setString('user_username', user.username);
      await prefs.setString('user_phone', user.phone);
      await prefs.setString('user_role', user.role);
      await prefs.setString('auth_token', token);

      // Save FCM token to backend
      try {
        final fcmToken = await FCMService.getToken();
        if (fcmToken != null) {
          await _updateFCMToken(user.id, fcmToken);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        dev.log('Error saving FCM token: $e');
        // Continue even if FCM token save fails
      }

      if (user.isAdmin) {
        Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/admin');
      } else {
        Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/user');
      }

      _showSnackBar('Selamat datang, ${user.name}!');
    } catch (e) {
      String errorMessage = e
          .toString()
          .replaceFirst('Exception: ', '')
          .replaceFirst('Login failed: ', '')
          .replaceFirst('Exception:', '')
          .replaceFirst('Login failed:', '');

      // Clean up common error prefixes
      if (errorMessage.startsWith('Exception: ')) {
        errorMessage = errorMessage.substring(11);
      }
      if (errorMessage.startsWith('Login failed: ')) {
        errorMessage = errorMessage.substring(14);
      }

      // Default user-friendly messages
      if (errorMessage.contains('Invalid credentials') ||
          errorMessage.contains('Unauthorized') ||
          errorMessage.contains('401')) {
        errorMessage = 'Username atau Password salah, harap coba lagi';
      } else if (errorMessage.contains('Connection refused') || errorMessage.contains('tidak dapat terhubung')) {
        errorMessage = 'Tidak dapat terhubung ke server, periksa koneksi internet';
      } else if (errorMessage.isEmpty) {
        errorMessage = 'Terjadi kesalahan, silakan coba lagi';
      }

      _showSnackBar(errorMessage);
    } finally {
      setState(() {
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _updateFCMToken(int userId, String token) async {
    try {
      final response = await http.put(
        Uri.parse('${Environment.baseUrl}/users/$userId/fcm-token'),
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json'},
        body: json.encode({'fcm_token': token}),
      );

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        dev.log('FCM token updated successfully');
      } else {
        dev.log('Failed to update FCM token: ${response.body}');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      dev.log('Error updating FCM token: $e');
    }
  }

  void _showSnackBar(String message) {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(
          message,
          style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
        ),
        backgroundColor: message.contains('Selamat datang') ? Colors.green[600] : Colors.red[600],
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
        margin: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        elevation: 6,
        duration: Duration(seconds: message.contains('Selamat datang') ? 2 : 4),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: Container(
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(gradient: AppColors.backgroundGradient),
        child: SafeArea(
          child: Center(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  // Ikon gedung
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.2), shape: BoxShape.circle),
                    child: const Icon(Icons.business, size: 80, color: Colors.white),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 32),

                  // Judul
                  const Text(
                    'BPS Cleaning System',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 28, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.white),
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),

                  // Subjudul
                  const Text(
                    'Sistem Manajemen Kebersihan\nBPS Kota Sukabumi',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, color: Colors.white70),
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 48),

                  // Form container
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      boxShadow: [
                        BoxShadow(color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.1), blurRadius: 10, offset: const Offset(0, 5)),
                      ],
                    ),
                    child: Column(
                      children: [
                        // Username field
                        TextFormField(
                          controller: _usernameController,
                          decoration: const InputDecoration(
                            labelText: 'Username',
                            prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.person),
                            border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                          ),
                          keyboardType: TextInputType.text,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),

                        // Password field
                        TextFormField(
                          controller: _passwordController,
                          obscureText: true,
                          decoration: const InputDecoration(
                            labelText: 'Password',
                            prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.lock),
                            border: OutlineInputBorder(),

                        // Login button

  @override

## 5. Update FCMService untuk Menggunakan Firebase Options

```dart
import 'package:firebase_core/firebase_core.dart';
import 'package:firebase_messaging/firebase_messaging.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import 'dart:developer' as dev;
import '../firebase_options.dart';

// Background message handler
@pragma('vm:entry-point')
Future<void> _firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler(RemoteMessage message) async {
  await Firebase.initializeApp(options: DefaultFirebaseOptions.currentPlatform);
  dev.log('Background message: ${message.notification?.title}');
}

class FCMService {
  static final FirebaseMessaging _messaging = FirebaseMessaging.instance;

  // Initialize FCM
  static Future<void> initialize() async {
    await Firebase.initializeApp();

    // Request permission (Android 13+)
    NotificationSettings settings = await _messaging.requestPermission(alert: true, badge: true, sound: true);

    if (settings.authorizationStatus == AuthorizationStatus.authorized) {
      dev.log('FCM: User granted permission');
    }

    // Register background handler
    FirebaseMessaging.onBackgroundMessage(_firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler);

    // Handle foreground messages
    FirebaseMessaging.onMessage.listen((RemoteMessage message) {
      dev.log('Foreground message: ${message.notification?.title}');

      if (message.notification != null) {
        Get.snackbar(
          message.notification!.title ?? 'Notifikasi',
          message.notification!.body ?? '',
          snackPosition: SnackPosition.TOP,
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 5),
        );
      }
    });

    // Handle notification tap (app opened from terminated state)
    FirebaseMessaging.onMessageOpenedApp.listen((RemoteMessage message) {
      dev.log('Message tapped: ${message.data}');
      _handleNotificationTap(message.data);
    });

    // Check if app was opened from notification (terminated state)
    RemoteMessage? initialMessage = await _messaging.getInitialMessage();
    if (initialMessage != null) {
      _handleNotificationTap(initialMessage.data);
    }
  }

  // Get FCM token
  static Future<String?> getToken() async {
    try {
      String? token = await _messaging.getToken();
      dev.log('FCM Token: $token');
      return token;
    } catch (e) {
      dev.log('Error getting FCM token: $e');
      return null;
    }
  }

  // Handle notification tap navigation
  static void _handleNotificationTap(Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    String? type = data['type'];

    switch (type) {
      case 'new_assignment':
        Get.offAllNamed('/user'); // Navigate to user home
        break;
      case 'report_reviewed':
        Get.offAllNamed('/user'); // Navigate to user riwayat
        break;
      case 'new_report':
        Get.offAllNamed('/admin'); // Navigate to admin laporan
        break;
    }
  }
}

```

    "editor.wordBasedSuggestions": "off"
  }
}
```

### Fungsinya:
- **Format on save**: Auto-format code saat save file
- **Line length 120**: Standar untuk Flutter
- **Fix linter**: Auto-fix error yang bisa diperbaiki otomatis
- **Dart-specific settings**: Optimasi untuk development Dart/Flutter

## ⚠️ Kalau Anda Punya Settings Penting Sebelumnya:

Kalau sebelumnya ada settings.json dengan konfigurasi penting (misal: custom paths, extensions, dll), **file tersebut ter-overwrite**.

### Cara Restore (jika perlu):
1. Tekan `Ctrl+Z` di VS Code (undo)
2. Atau cek Git history: `git diff .vscode/settings.json`
3. Merge dengan settings lama yang penting

### Apakah Settings Ini Boleh Dihapus?
**BOLEH!** File ini **OPSIONAL**. Kalau dihapus, VS Code akan pakai default settings dan tidak ada masalah.

  "dart.lineLength": 120,                    // Max line length untuk Dart

  "editor.codeActionsOnSave": {
    "source.fixAll": "explicit"              // Auto-fix linter errors
  },
  "[dart]": {                                 // Settings khusus Dart
    "editor.formatOnSave": true,
    "editor.formatOnType": true,
    "editor.rulers": [120],
    "editor.selectionHighlight": false,
    "editor.suggest.snippetsPreventQuickSuggestions": false,

    "editor.wordBasedSuggestions": "off"
  }
}
```

import 'dart:io';

class Environment {
  // ================================
  // KONFIGURASI IP ADDRESS
  // ================================

  // IP Address PC Anda di jaringan lokal
  // Cara cek: Buka CMD/Terminal, ketik: ipconfig (Windows) atau ifconfig (Mac/Linux)
  // Cari IPv4 Address, contoh: 192.168.1.100
  static const String localNetworkIP = '192.168.110.128'; // IP PC Anda

  // Debug mode detection
  static bool get isDebug {
    bool debugMode = false;
    assert(debugMode = true);
    return debugMode;
  }

  // ================================
  // AUTO DETECTION
  // ================================

  static String get baseUrl {
    if (Platform.isAndroid) {
      // Android: Gunakan emulator atau device fisik?
      return useEmulator ? emulatorUrl : deviceUrl;
    } else if (Platform.isIOS) {
      // iOS Simulator
      return 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api';
    } else {
      // Web atau platform lain
      return 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api';
    }
  }

  // ================================
  // SWITCH MODE
  // ================================

  // Set ke TRUE jika pakai emulator, FALSE jika pakai device fisik
  static const bool useEmulator = true; // ⚠️ UBAH INI SESUAI KEBUTUHAN!

  // ================================
  // URL CONFIGURATIONS
  // ================================

  // URL untuk Android Emulator
  static const String emulatorUrl = 'http://10.0.2.2:8000/api';

  // URL untuk Device Fisik (menggunakan IP lokal)
  static String get deviceUrl => 'http://$localNetworkIP:8000/api';

  // ================================
  // HELPER INFO
  // ================================

  static String get currentMode {
    if (Platform.isAndroid) {
      return useEmulator ? 'Android Emulator' : 'Android Device Fisik';
    } else if (Platform.isIOS) {
      return 'iOS Simulator';
    } else {
      return 'Web/Desktop';
    }
  }

  static void printConfig() {
    print('═══════════════════════════════════════');
    print('📱 Environment Configuration');
    print('═══════════════════════════════════════');
    print('Mode: $currentMode');
    print('Base URL: $baseUrl');
    print('Local IP: $localNetworkIP');
    print('═══════════════════════════════════════');
  }
}

### **Step 3: Improve Error Handling (Timeout Message)**

```dart
// Core Dart libraries
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:developer' as dev;

// External packages
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

// Internal imports
import '../../config/api_config.dart';
import '../../config/environment.dart';

// Cache entry structure - moved to top level
class CacheEntry {
  final dynamic data;
  final DateTime timestamp;

  CacheEntry(this.data, this.timestamp);

  bool isExpired(Duration timeout) => DateTime.now().difference(timestamp) > timeout;
}

class ApiService {
  // Singleton pattern untuk reuse HTTP client
  static final http.Client _client = http.Client();

  // Cache untuk responses
  static final Map<String, CacheEntry> _cache = {};
  static const Duration _cacheTimeout = Duration(minutes: 5);

  // Base URL dari konfigurasi
  static String get baseUrl => ApiConfig.baseUrl;

  // Headers untuk request
  static Map<String, String> get headers => ApiConfig.defaultHeaders;

  // Helper method untuk logging (only in debug mode)
  static void _logRequest(String method, String url, Map<String, dynamic>? body) {
    if (Environment.isDebug) {
      dev.log('API Request: $method $url');
      if (body != null) {
        dev.log('Request Body: ${json.encode(body)}');
      }
    }
  }

  static void _logResponse(http.Response response) {
    if (Environment.isDebug) {
      dev.log('API Response: ${response.statusCode}');
      dev.log('Response Body: ${response.body}');
    }
  }

  static void _logError(String method, String url, dynamic error) {
    if (Environment.isDebug) {
      dev.log('API Error: $method $url - $error');
    }
  }

  // Cache management
  static T? _getFromCache<T>(String key) {
    final entry = _cache[key];
    if (entry != null && !entry.isExpired(_cacheTimeout)) {
      return entry.data as T?;
    }
    _cache.remove(key);
    return null;
  }

  static void _saveToCache<T>(String key, T data) {
    _cache[key] = CacheEntry(data, DateTime.now());
  }

  static void _removeFromCache(String key) {
    _cache.remove(key);
  }

  static void clearAssignmentCache() {
    // Clear all assignment-related cache entries
    _cache.removeWhere((key, value) => key.contains('assignments') || key.contains('assignment'));
    if (Environment.isDebug) {
      dev.log('Assignment cache cleared');
    }
  }

  static void clearCache() {
    _cache.clear();
  }

  // Get all users (staff) with caching
  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getUsers({bool useCache = true}) async {
    const String method = 'GET';
    final String url = '$baseUrl/users';
    const String cacheKey = 'users_list';

    try {
      // Check cache first
      if (useCache) {
        final cachedData = _getFromCache<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(cacheKey);
        if (cachedData != null) {
          return cachedData;
        }
      }

      _logRequest(method, url, null);

      final response = await _client.get(Uri.parse(url), headers: headers).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      _logResponse(response);

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final data = json.decode(response.body);
        if (data['success'] == true) {
          final result = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(data['data'] ?? []);
          if (useCache) {
            _saveToCache(cacheKey, result);
          }
          return result;
        } else {
          throw Exception(data['message'] ?? 'Gagal memuat data users');
        }
      } else {
        try {
          final errorData = json.decode(response.body);
          throw Exception(errorData['message'] ?? 'Failed to load users: ${response.statusCode}');
        } catch (e) {
          throw Exception('Failed to load users: ${response.statusCode}');
        }
      }
    } on TimeoutException {
      _logError(method, url, 'Request timeout');
      throw Exception('Request timeout. Periksa koneksi internet Anda.');
    } catch (e) {
      _logError(method, url, e);
      if (e is Exception) {
        rethrow;
      }
      throw Exception('Gagal terhubung ke server. Periksa koneksi internet Anda.');
    }
  }

  // Create new user
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> createUser({
    required String name,
    required String username,
    required String phone,
    required String password,
    required String role,
  }) async {
    const String method = 'POST';
    final String url = '$baseUrl/users';

    try {
      _logRequest(method, url, {'name': name, 'username': username, 'phone': phone, 'password': '***', 'role': role});

      final response = await _client
          .post(
            Uri.parse(url),
            headers: headers,
            body: json.encode({'name': name, 'username': username, 'phone': phone, 'password': password, 'role': role}),
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      _logResponse(response);

      if (response.statusCode == 201) {
        final result = json.decode(response.body);

        // Clear users cache after successful creation
        _removeFromCache('users_list');

        if (Environment.isDebug) {
          dev.log('User created successfully, cache cleared');
        }

        return result;
      } else {
        final error = json.decode(response.body);
        throw Exception(error['message'] ?? 'Failed to create user');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _logError(method, url, e);
      throw Exception('Error creating user: $e');
    }
  }

  // Update user
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> updateUser({
    required int id,
    required String name,
    required String username,
    required String phone,
    String? password,
    required String role,
  }) async {
    const String method = 'PUT';
    final String url = '$baseUrl/users/$id';

    try {
      final body = {'name': name, 'username': username, 'phone': phone, 'role': role};

      if (password != null && password.isNotEmpty) {
        body['password'] = password;
      }

      _logRequest(method, url, body);

      final response = await _client
          .put(Uri.parse(url), headers: headers, body: json.encode(body))
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      _logResponse(response);

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final result = json.decode(response.body);

        // Clear users cache after successful update
        _removeFromCache('users_list');

        if (Environment.isDebug) {
          dev.log('User updated successfully, cache cleared');
        }

        return result;
      } else {
        final error = json.decode(response.body);
        throw Exception(error['message'] ?? 'Failed to update user');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _logError(method, url, e);
      throw Exception('Error updating user: $e');
    }
  }

  // Delete user
  static Future<void> deleteUser(int id) async {
    const String method = 'DELETE';
    final String url = '$baseUrl/users/$id';

    try {
      _logRequest(method, url, null);

      final response = await _client.delete(Uri.parse(url), headers: headers).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      _logResponse(response);

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        // Clear users cache after successful deletion
        _removeFromCache('users_list');

        if (Environment.isDebug) {
          dev.log('User deleted successfully, cache cleared');
        }
      } else {
        final error = json.decode(response.body);
        throw Exception(error['message'] ?? 'Failed to delete user');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _logError(method, url, e);
      throw Exception('Error deleting user: $e');
    }
  }

  // Login
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> login({required String username, required String password}) async {
    const String method = 'POST';
    final String url = '$baseUrl/login';
    final Map<String, dynamic> body = {'username': username, 'password': password};

    try {
      _logRequest(method, url, body);

      final response = await http
          .post(Uri.parse(url), headers: headers, body: json.encode(body))
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      _logResponse(response);

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final data = json.decode(response.body);
        if (data['success'] == true) {
          return data;
        } else {
          throw Exception(data['message'] ?? 'Login gagal');
        }
      } else if (response.statusCode == 401) {
        // Handle unauthorized
        try {
          final errorData = json.decode(response.body);
          throw Exception(errorData['message'] ?? 'Username atau Password salah, harap coba lagi');
        } catch (e) {
          throw Exception('Username atau Password salah, harap coba lagi');
        }
      } else {
        // Handle other errors
        try {
          final errorData = json.decode(response.body);
          throw Exception(errorData['message'] ?? 'Terjadi kesalahan server (${response.statusCode})');
        } catch (e) {
          throw Exception('Terjadi kesalahan server (${response.statusCode})');
        }
      }
    } on TimeoutException catch (e) {
      _logError(method, url, e);
      throw Exception(
        'Koneksi timeout. Pastikan:\n• HP dan PC terhubung ke WiFi yang sama\n• Server Laravel berjalan di ${Environment.baseUrl.replaceAll('/api', '')}\n• Firewall tidak memblokir koneksi',
      );
    } on http.ClientException catch (e) {
      _logError(method, url, e);
      throw Exception(
        'Tidak dapat terhubung ke server. Pastikan:\n• HP dan PC terhubung ke WiFi yang sama\n• Server Laravel berjalan di ${Environment.baseUrl.replaceAll('/api', '')}',
      );
    } on FormatException catch (e) {
      _logError(method, url, e);
      throw Exception('Server mengembalikan response yang tidak valid');
    } catch (e) {
      _logError(method, url, e);
      if (e is Exception) {
        rethrow;
      }
      throw Exception('Gagal terhubung ke server. Periksa koneksi internet Anda.');
    }
  }

  // Logout
  static Future<void> logout(String token) async {
    try {
      final response = await http.post(
        Uri.parse('$baseUrl/logout'),
        headers: {...headers, 'Authorization': 'Bearer $token'},
      );

      if (response.statusCode != 200) {
        throw Exception('Failed to logout');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      throw Exception('Error during logout: $e');
    }
  }

  // ==========================================
  // AREAS API ENDPOINTS
  // ==========================================

  // Get all areas with optional search
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getAreas({String? search, bool useCache = true}) async {
    const String method = 'GET';
    String url = '$baseUrl/areas';
    if (search != null && search.isNotEmpty) {
      url += '?search=$search';
    }
    final String cacheKey = 'areas_${search ?? 'all'}';

    try {
      // Check cache first
      if (useCache) {
        final cachedData = _getFromCache<Map<String, dynamic>>(cacheKey);
        if (cachedData != null) {
          return cachedData;
        }
      }

      _logRequest(method, url, null);

      final response = await _client.get(Uri.parse(url), headers: headers).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      _logResponse(response);

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final result = json.decode(response.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        if (useCache) {
          _saveToCache(cacheKey, result);
        }
        return result;
      } else {
        throw Exception('Failed to load areas: ${response.statusCode}');
      }
    } on TimeoutException {
      _logError(method, url, 'Request timeout');
      throw Exception('Request timeout. Periksa koneksi internet Anda.');
    } catch (e) {
      _logError(method, url, e);
      if (e is Exception) {
        rethrow;
      }
      throw Exception('Network error: $e');
    }
  }

  // Create new area
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> createArea({
    required String name,
    required String lantai,
    required String nomorRuangan,
    required List<String> kebersihan,
    required String keterangan,
  }) async {
    const String method = 'POST';
    final String url = '$baseUrl/areas';

    try {
      final requestBody = {
        'name': name,
        'lantai': lantai,
        'nomorRuangan': nomorRuangan,
        'kebersihan': kebersihan,
        'keterangan': keterangan,
      };

      _logRequest(method, url, requestBody);

      final response = await _client
          .post(Uri.parse(url), headers: headers, body: json.encode(requestBody))
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

      _logResponse(response);

      final responseData = json.decode(response.body);

      if (response.statusCode == 201) {
        // Clear areas cache
        _cache.removeWhere((key, value) => key.startsWith('areas_'));

        if (Environment.isDebug) {
          dev.log('Area created successfully, cache cleared');
        }

        return responseData;
      } else {
        throw Exception(responseData['message'] ?? 'Failed to create area');
      }
    } on TimeoutException {
      _logError(method, url, 'Request timeout');
      throw Exception('Request timeout. Periksa koneksi internet Anda.');
    } catch (e) {
      _logError(method, url, e);
      if (e is Exception) {
        rethrow;
      }
      throw Exception('Network error: $e');
    }
  }

  // Update area
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> updateArea({
    required int id,
    required String name,
    required String lantai,
    required String nomorRuangan,
    required List<String> kebersihan,
    required String keterangan,
  }) async {
    const String method = 'PUT';

    try {

      _logRequest(method, url, requestBody);

          .put(Uri.parse(url), headers: headers, body: json.encode(requestBody))

    } on TimeoutException {

    } catch (e) {
      _logError(method, url, e);
      if (e is Exception) {
        rethrow;
      }
      throw Exception('Network error: $e');
    }
  }

  // Delete area
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> deleteArea(int id) async {
    const String method = 'DELETE';
    final String url = '$baseUrl/areas/$id';

    try {
      _logRequest(method, url, null);

      final response = await _client.delete(Uri.parse(url), headers: headers).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));

## 🎯 SOLUSI: Multi-Environment Configuration

```dart
import 'dart:io';

class Environment {
  // ================================
  // 🎯 PILIH MODE (UBAH SESUAI KEBUTUHAN)
  // ================================
  
  // Mode yang tersedia:
  // - 'development' : Testing di local (emulator/device fisik)
  // - 'production'  : Deploy ke server production (BPS)
  static const String mode = 'development'; // ⚠️ UBAH KE 'production' SAAT DEPLOY!

  // ================================
  // 🌐 PRODUCTION SERVER (UNTUK DEPLOYMENT)
  // ================================
  
  // URL server production BPS (ganti dengan domain/IP server sebenarnya)
  // Contoh:
  // - 'http://192.168.1.100:8000/api'  (IP server lokal BPS)
  // - 'http://bps.go.id/cleaning-api'  (Domain production)
  // - 'https://api.bps-cleaning.com'   (Domain dengan SSL)
  static const String productionUrl = 'http://SERVER_IP_ANDA:8000/api'; // ⚠️ GANTI SEBELUM DEPLOY!

  // ================================
  // 🔧 DEVELOPMENT CONFIG (UNTUK TESTING)
  // ================================

  // IP Address PC Developer (hanya untuk development)
  // Cara cek: ipconfig (Windows) atau ifconfig (Mac/Linux)
  static const String localNetworkIP = '192.168.110.128'; // IP PC untuk development

  // Set TRUE = emulator, FALSE = device fisik
  static const bool useEmulator = false;

  // ================================
  // 🚀 AUTO SELECTION
  // ================================

  static String get baseUrl {
    // Jika mode production, gunakan URL production
    if (mode == 'production') {
      return productionUrl;
    }

    // Jika development
    if (Platform.isAndroid) {
      return useEmulator ? emulatorUrl : deviceUrl;
    } else if (Platform.isIOS) {
      return 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api';
    } else {
      return 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api';
    }
  }

  // ================================
  // URL CONFIGURATIONS
  // ================================

  // URL untuk Android Emulator
  static const String emulatorUrl = 'http://10.0.2.2:8000/api';

  // URL untuk Device Fisik (development)
  static String get deviceUrl => 'http://$localNetworkIP:8000/api';

  // ================================
  // HELPER INFO
  // ================================

  static String get currentMode {
    if (Platform.isAndroid) {
      return useEmulator ? 'Android Emulator' : 'Android Device Fisik';
    } else if (Platform.isIOS) {
      return 'iOS Simulator';
    } else {
      return 'Web/Desktop';
    }
  }

  static void printConfig() {
    print('═══════════════════════════════════════');
    print('📱 Environment Configuration');
    print('═══════════════════════════════════════');
    print('Mode: $currentMode');
    print('Base URL: $baseUrl');
    print('Local IP: $localNetworkIP');
    print('═══════════════════════════════════════');
  }
}

  // - 'http://192.168.1.100:8000/api'  (IP server lokal BPS)
  // - 'http://bps.go.id/cleaning-api'  (Domain production)
  // - 'https://api.bps-cleaning.com'   (Domain dengan SSL)
  static const String productionUrl = 'http://SERVER_IP_ANDA:8000/api'; // ⚠️ GANTI SEBELUM DEPLOY!

  // ================================
  // 🔧 DEVELOPMENT CONFIG (UNTUK TESTING)
  // ================================

  // IP Address PC Developer (hanya untuk development)
  // Cara cek: ipconfig (Windows) atau ifconfig (Mac/Linux)
  static const String localNetworkIP = '192.168.110.128'; // IP PC untuk development

  // Set TRUE = emulator, FALSE = device fisik
  static const bool useEmulator = false;

  // ================================
  // 🚀 AUTO SELECTION
  // ================================

  static String get baseUrl {
    // Jika mode production, gunakan URL production
    if (mode == 'production') {
      return productionUrl;
    }

    // Jika development
    if (Platform.isAndroid) {
      return useEmulator ? emulatorUrl : deviceUrl;
    } else if (Platform.isIOS) {
      return 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api';
    } else {
      return 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api';
    }
  }

  // ================================
  // URL CONFIGURATIONS
  // ================================

  // URL untuk Android Emulator
  static const String emulatorUrl = 'http://10.0.2.2:8000/api';

  // URL untuk Device Fisik (development)
  static String get deviceUrl => 'http://$localNetworkIP:8000/api';

  // ================================
  // HELPER INFO
  // ================================

  static String get currentMode {
    if (mode == 'production') {
      return '🚀 PRODUCTION';
    }
    
    if (Platform.isAndroid) {
      return useEmulator ? '🔧 DEV - Android Emulator' : '🔧 DEV - Android Device Fisik';
    } else if (Platform.isIOS) {
      return '🔧 DEV - iOS Simulator';
    } else {
      return '🔧 DEV - Web/Desktop';
    }
  }

  static void printConfig() {
    print('═══════════════════════════════════════');
    print('📱 BPS Cleaning System - API Config');
    print('═══════════════════════════════════════');
    print('Environment: $currentMode');
    print('Base URL: $baseUrl');
    if (mode == 'development') {
      print('Dev IP: $localNetworkIP');
    }
    print('═══════════════════════════════════════');
  }
}

```

Sekarang buat dokumentasi deployment:

```markdown
# 📱 BPS Cleaning System - Panduan Deployment

## 🎯 Overview

Aplikasi ini memiliki **2 mode**:
- **Development**: Untuk testing di local (PC developer)
- **Production**: Untuk deployment ke server BPS

---

## 🔧 DEVELOPMENT MODE (Testing)

### Untuk Developer/Tester

**1. Setup Backend Laravel:**

```bash
cd backend
php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8000
```

**2. Konfigurasi Flutter (`lib/config/environment.dart`):**

```dart
static const String mode = 'development';  // Mode development
static const String localNetworkIP = 'IP_PC_ANDA';  // Ganti dengan IP PC
static const bool useEmulator = false;  // true = emulator, false = HP fisik
```

**3. Cek IP PC:**

- **Windows**: `ipconfig` → cari IPv4 Address
- **Mac/Linux**: `ifconfig` → cari inet

**4. Run App:**

```bash
flutter run -d <device_id>
```

---

## 🚀 PRODUCTION MODE (Deployment)

### Langkah-Langkah Deployment ke Server BPS

### **A. Setup Backend di Server**

**1. Install di Server BPS:**

```bash
# Transfer folder backend ke server
# Install dependencies
cd backend
composer install --optimize-autoloader --no-dev

# Setup .env
cp .env.example .env
php artisan key:generate

# Setup database
php artisan migrate --force

# Setup storage
php artisan storage:link
```

**2. Setup Webserver (Apache/Nginx):**

Contoh konfigurasi Nginx:

```nginx
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name api.bps-cleaning.local;
    root /var/www/bps-cleaning-backend/public;

    index index.php;

    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.php?$query_string;
    }

    location ~ \.php$ {
        fastcgi_pass unix:/var/run/php/php8.2-fpm.sock;
        fastcgi_index index.php;
        include fastcgi_params;
    }
}
```

**3. Catat URL/IP Server:**

Misal server di: `http://192.168.1.100` atau `http://api.bps-cleaning.local`

---

### **B. Build Flutter App untuk Production**

**1. Update Config (`lib/config/environment.dart`):**

```dart
static const String mode = 'production';  // ⚠️ UBAH KE PRODUCTION!

// Ganti dengan IP/domain server BPS yang sebenarnya
static const String productionUrl = 'http://192.168.1.100:8000/api';
// Atau: 'http://api.bps-cleaning.local/api'
// Atau: 'https://api.bps-cleaning.com/api'
```

**2. Build APK Production:**

```bash
# Build APK
flutter build apk --release

# Atau build App Bundle (untuk Play Store)
flutter build appbundle --release
```

**3. APK Result:**

```
build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk
```

**4. Distribute ke User:**

- Copy APK ke semua HP petugas
- Install APK
- Semua petugas akan connect ke **server production yang sama**

---

## 📝 Checklist Deployment

### ✅ Backend
- [ ] Backend di-deploy ke server dengan IP/domain tetap
- [ ] Database sudah di-migrate
- [ ] Storage folder sudah di-link
- [ ] `.env` sudah dikonfigurasi (DB, Firebase Server Key)
- [ ] Server bisa diakses dari jaringan lokal/internet

### ✅ Frontend
- [ ] File `environment.dart` mode diubah ke `'production'`
- [ ] `productionUrl` diisi dengan IP/domain server yang benar
- [ ] Build APK dengan `flutter build apk --release`
- [ ] Test APK di minimal 2 HP berbeda
- [ ] Notifikasi Firebase sudah ditest

---

## 🔄 Switch Between Modes

### Development → Production:
```dart
// lib/config/environment.dart
static const String mode = 'production';  // Ubah dari 'development'
```

### Production → Development:
```dart
// lib/config/environment.dart
static const String mode = 'development';  // Ubah dari 'production'
```

---

## ⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTES

1. **Satu Server untuk Semua User**
   - Semua HP petugas connect ke server production yang sama
   - Tidak perlu ubah IP per HP
   - IP hanya di-set sekali saat build APK

2. **Server Harus Accessible**
   - Server harus bisa diakses dari semua HP petugas
   - Jika internal: pastikan semua HP dalam 1 jaringan
   - Jika internet: gunakan domain dan SSL

3. **Firebase Configuration**
   - `google-services.json` sudah ada di project
   - Backend `.env` harus ada `FIREBASE_SERVER_KEY`
   - Test notifikasi sebelum deploy

4. **Security**
   - Untuk production, gunakan HTTPS (SSL)
   - Set `.env` `APP_ENV=production`
   - Set `.env` `APP_DEBUG=false`

---

## 🆘 Troubleshooting

### "Timeout Exception"
- Pastikan server berjalan
- Cek IP/domain di `environment.dart` sudah benar
- Test akses server dari browser HP: `http://SERVER_IP:8000`

### "Connection Refused"
- Firewall mungkin memblokir port 8000
- Pastikan server listen ke `0.0.0.0`, bukan `127.0.0.1`

### "Notifikasi Tidak Masuk"
- Cek backend `.env` ada `FIREBASE_SERVER_KEY`
- Cek HP sudah dapat izin notifikasi
- Cek FCM token tersimpan di database

---

## 📞 Support

Jika ada masalah deployment, hubungi developer atau cek dokumentasi lengkap di folder `docs/`.

---

**Version**: 1.0.0  
**Last Updated**: Oktober 2025

## 🐛 ANALISIS BUG

Bug terjadi karena **controller di-reinitialize** setiap kali widget rebuild. Saat TextField focus/typing → widget rebuild → controller baru dibuat → `completedTasks` hilang!

## ✅ SOLUSI

Ubah cara inisialisasi controller agar tidak di-recreate:

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../../admin/modules/area/controllers/area_controller.dart';
import '../controllers/cleaning_task_controller.dart';

class CleaningTaskDialog extends StatelessWidget {
  final Area area;

  const CleaningTaskDialog({Key? key, required this.area}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Use Get.find() to reuse existing controller or create new one with tag
    final controller = Get.isRegistered<CleaningTaskController>(tag: 'dialog_${area.id}')
        ? Get.find<CleaningTaskController>(tag: 'dialog_${area.id}')
        : Get.put(CleaningTaskController(), tag: 'dialog_${area.id}');

    // Set selected area when dialog opens (only once)
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (controller.selectedArea.value?.id != area.id) {
        controller.setSelectedArea(area);
      }
    });

    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: Container(
        width: MediaQuery.of(context).size.width,
        height: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height * 0.85,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            // Header with close button
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 16, 16, 0),
              child: Row(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    area.name,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 20,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: Colors.black,
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    onPressed: () {
                      controller.clearForm();
                      Get.back();
                    },
                    icon: const Icon(
                      Icons.close,
                      color: Colors.black,
                      size: 28,
                    ),
                    padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    constraints: const BoxConstraints(),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),

            // Content
            Expanded(
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 8, 24, 24),

                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

                    _buildNotes(controller),
                    const SizedBox(height: 32),

                    // Submit Button
                    _buildSubmitButton(controller),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: Container(

                  style: const TextStyle(

            ),
          ),

        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        Expanded(
          child: Container(
