```dart
  Widget _buildTodoList(CleaningTaskController controller) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        const Text(
          'Kebersihan yang dikerjakan',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 16,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            color: Colors.black,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        Obx(() {
          if (controller.isLoading.value) {
            return const Center(
              child: Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.all(20),
                child: CircularProgressIndicator(),
              ),
            );
          }

          if (controller.cleaningTasks.isEmpty) {
            return Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: const Center(
                child: Text(
                  'Tidak ada tugas pembersihan untuk area ini',
                  style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 14),
                ),
              ),
            );
          }

          return ListView.builder(
            shrinkWrap: true,
            physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            itemCount: controller.cleaningTasks.length,
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              final task = controller.cleaningTasks[index];
              final taskId = task['id'] ?? index;
              return Obx(() {
                final isCompleted = controller.completedTasks.contains(taskId);
                return Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                  child: Row(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Checkbox(
                        value: isCompleted,
                        onChanged: (value) {
                          controller.toggleTaskCompletion(taskId);
                        },
                        materialTapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
                        visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          task['task_name'] ?? 'Tugas ${index + 1}',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 14,
                            color: Colors.black87,
                            decoration: isCompleted
                                ? TextDecoration.lineThrough
                                : null,
                            decorationColor: Colors.grey,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                );
              });
            },
          );
        }),
      ],
    );
  }

                height: 120,
                width: double.infinity,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey[300]!, width: 1),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                ),
                child: const Column(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [

                      'Choose File',
                      style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 14),
                    ),
                    Text(
                      'No File Chosen',
                      style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 12),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            );
          }

          return SizedBox(
            height: 100,
            child: ListView.builder(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              itemCount: controller.photoBukti.length,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final photo = controller.photoBukti[index];
                return Container(

                  child: Stack(

          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            hintText: 'Contoh: Lantai sudah dipel, meja sudah dirapihkan',
            hintStyle: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 14),
            border: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey[300]!),
            ),
            enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey[300]!),
            ),
            focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF2196F3)),
            ),
            contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),

  Widget _buildSubmitButton(CleaningTaskController controller) {
    return Obx(() {
      return SizedBox(

        height: 50,
        child: ElevatedButton(
          onPressed: controller.isLoading.value
              ? null
              : () {
                  controller.submitCleaningReport();

          child: controller.isLoading.value
              ? const SizedBox(

                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),

  void _showImageSourceDialog(CleaningTaskController controller) {
    Get.dialog(
      AlertDialog(

        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,

              onTap: () {
                Get.back();
                controller.pickImageFromGallery();
              },
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../../../../admin/modules/area/controllers/area_controller.dart';
import '../controllers/cleaning_task_controller.dart';

class CleaningTaskDialog extends StatelessWidget {
  final Area area;

  const CleaningTaskDialog({Key? key, required this.area}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Use Get.find() to reuse existing controller or create new one with tag
    final controller = Get.isRegistered<CleaningTaskController>(tag: 'dialog_${area.id}')
        ? Get.find<CleaningTaskController>(tag: 'dialog_${area.id}')
        : Get.put(CleaningTaskController(), tag: 'dialog_${area.id}');

    // Set selected area when dialog opens (only once)
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (controller.selectedArea.value?.id != area.id) {
        controller.setSelectedArea(area);
      }
    });

    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: Container(
        width: MediaQuery.of(context).size.width,
        height: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height * 0.85,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            // Header with close button
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 16, 16, 0),
              child: Row(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    area.name,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 20,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: Colors.black,
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    onPressed: () {
                      controller.clearForm();
                      Get.back();
                      // Delete controller setelah dialog ditutup
                      Get.delete<CleaningTaskController>(tag: 'dialog_${area.id}');
                    },
                    icon: const Icon(
                      Icons.close,
                      color: Colors.black,
                      size: 28,
                    ),
                    padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    constraints: const BoxConstraints(),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),

            // Content
            Expanded(
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 8, 24, 24),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    // Area Details
                    _buildAreaDetails(),
                    const SizedBox(height: 24),

                    // To Do List
                    _buildTodoList(controller),
                    const SizedBox(height: 24),

                    // Photo Upload
                    _buildPhotoUpload(controller),
                    const SizedBox(height: 24),

                    // Notes
                    _buildNotes(controller),
                    const SizedBox(height: 32),

                    // Submit Button
                    _buildSubmitButton(controller),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAreaDetails() {
    return Row(
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.grey[100],
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
            ),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                const Text(
                  'Lantai',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    color: Colors.grey,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                  area.lantai,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 16,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color: Colors.black,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        Expanded(
          child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.grey[100],
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
            ),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                const Text(
                  'No. Ruangan',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    color: Colors.grey,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                  area.nomorRuangan,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 16,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color: Colors.black,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTodoList(CleaningTaskController controller) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        const Text(
          'Kebersihan yang dikerjakan',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 16,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            color: Colors.black,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        Obx(() {
          if (controller.isLoading.value) {
            return const Center(
              child: Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.all(20),
                child: CircularProgressIndicator(),
              ),
            );
          }

          if (controller.cleaningTasks.isEmpty) {
            return Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: const Center(
                child: Text(
                  'Tidak ada tugas pembersihan untuk area ini',
                  style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 14),
                ),
              ),
            );
          }

          return ListView.builder(
            shrinkWrap: true,
            physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            itemCount: controller.cleaningTasks.length,
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              final task = controller.cleaningTasks[index];
              final taskId = task['id'] ?? index;
              return Obx(() {
                final isCompleted = controller.completedTasks.contains(taskId);
                return Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                  child: Row(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Checkbox(
                        value: isCompleted,
                        onChanged: (value) {
                          controller.toggleTaskCompletion(taskId);
                        },
                        materialTapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
                        visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(

                          style: TextStyle(

                                ? TextDecoration.lineThrough
                                : null,
                            decorationColor: Colors.grey,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                );
              });
            },
          );
        }),
      ],
    );
  }

            height: 100,
            child: ListView.builder(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              itemCount: controller.photoBukti.length,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final photo = controller.photoBukti[index];
                return Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
                  width: 80,
                  height: 80,
                  child: Stack(
                    children: [
                      ClipRRect(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                        child: Image.file(
                          photo,
                          fit: BoxFit.cover,
                          width: 80,
                          height: 80,
                        ),
                      ),
                      Positioned(
                        top: 4,
                        right: 4,
                        child: GestureDetector(
                          onTap: () => controller.removePhoto(index),
                          child: Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(2),
                            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                              color: Colors.red,
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            ),
                            child: const Icon(
                              Icons.close,
                              color: Colors.white,
                              size: 16,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          );
        }),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNotes(CleaningTaskController controller) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        const Text(
          'Catatan Pembersihan',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 16,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            color: Colors.black,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        TextField(
          controller: controller.catatanController,
          maxLines: 4,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            hintText: 'Contoh: Lantai sudah dipel, meja sudah dirapihkan',
            hintStyle: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 14),
            border: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey[300]!),
            ),
            enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey[300]!),
            ),
            focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF2196F3)),
            ),
            contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSubmitButton(CleaningTaskController controller) {
    return Obx(() {
      return SizedBox(
        width: double.infinity,
        height: 50,
        child: ElevatedButton(
          onPressed: controller.isLoading.value
              ? null
              : () async {
                  await controller.submitCleaningReport();
                  // Delete controller setelah submit (jika dialog sudah tertutup)
                  if (!Get.isOverlaysOpen) {
                    Get.delete<CleaningTaskController>(tag: 'dialog_${area.id}');
                  }
                },
          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: Colors.black,
            foregroundColor: Colors.white,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
            ),
            elevation: 0,
          ),
          child: controller.isLoading.value
              ? const SizedBox(
                  width: 20,
                  height: 20,
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                    strokeWidth: 2,
                    valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(Colors.white),
                  ),
                )
              : const Text(
                  'Laporkan',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                ),
        ),
      );
    });
  }

  void _showImageSourceDialog(CleaningTaskController controller) {
    Get.dialog(
      AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Pilih Sumber Foto'),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.camera_alt),
              title: const Text('Kamera'),
              onTap: () {
                Get.back();
                controller.pickImage();
              },
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.photo_library),
              title: const Text('Galeri'),
              onTap: () {
                Get.back();
                controller.pickImageFromGallery();
              },
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,

              Container(

                  color: Colors.grey[500],
                  size: 18,
                ),

            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
```
```dart
import '../controllers/admin_profile_controller.dart';
import '../../../../core/constants/app_styles.dart';
```

**Cursor**

Baik, mari saya cek dan fix duplikasi popup saat menambahkan user:

Ketemu! Ada **2 popup** yang muncul:
1. Di **controller** (line 66-72): `Get.snackbar` ✅

Saya akan hapus yang di dialog, pertahankan yang di controller:

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../controllers/petugas_controller.dart';

class TambahPetugasDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback? onUserAdded;

  const TambahPetugasDialog({super.key, this.onUserAdded});

  @override
  State<TambahPetugasDialog> createState() => _TambahPetugasDialogState();
}

class _TambahPetugasDialogState extends State<TambahPetugasDialog> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _nameController = TextEditingController();
  final _phoneController = TextEditingController();
  final _usernameController = TextEditingController();
  final _passwordController = TextEditingController();
  final _confirmPasswordController = TextEditingController();

  String _selectedRole = 'user';
  bool _isObscuredPassword = true;
  bool _isObscuredConfirmPassword = true;

  final PetugasController _controller = Get.find<PetugasController>();

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameController.dispose();
    _phoneController.dispose();
    _usernameController.dispose();
    _passwordController.dispose();
    _confirmPasswordController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.7), // Dark overlay
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
      child: Container(
        width: double.maxFinite,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white, // Warna background dialog
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
              blurRadius: 15,
              offset: const Offset(0, 5),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Form(
            key: _formKey,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                // Header
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: const Color(0xFF2196F3).withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      ),
                      child: const Icon(
                        Icons.person_add,
                        color: Color(0xFF2196F3),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    const Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        'Tambah Petugas Baru',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 18,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
                      style: IconButton.styleFrom(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                        minimumSize: const Size(32, 32),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),

                // Name Field
                _buildTextField(
                  controller: _nameController,
                  label: 'Nama Lengkap',
                  hint: 'Masukkan nama lengkap',
                  icon: Icons.person,
                  validator: (value) {
                    if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
                      return 'Nama tidak boleh kosong';
                    }
                    if (value.trim().length < 3) {
                      return 'Nama minimal 3 karakter';
                    }
                    return null;
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Phone Field
                _buildTextField(
                  controller: _phoneController,
                  label: 'No. Telepon',
                  hint: 'Masukkan nomor telepon',
                  icon: Icons.phone,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.phone,
                  validator: (value) {
                    if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
                      return 'Nomor telepon tidak boleh kosong';
                    }
                    if (value.trim().length < 10) {
                      return 'Nomor telepon minimal 10 digit';
                    }
                    return null;
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Username Field
                _buildTextField(
                  controller: _usernameController,
                  label: 'Username',
                  hint: 'Masukkan username',
                  icon: Icons.alternate_email,
                  validator: (value) {
                    if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
                      return 'Username tidak boleh kosong';
                    }
                    if (value.trim().length < 3) {
                      return 'Username minimal 3 karakter';
                    }
                    if (value.contains(' ')) {
                      return 'Username tidak boleh mengandung spasi';
                    }
                    return null;
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Role Dropdown
                const Text(
                  'Role',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Container(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
                  ),
                  child: DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                    value: _selectedRole,
                    onChanged: (value) {
                      setState(() {
                        _selectedRole = value!;
                      });
                    },
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 16,
                        vertical: 12,
                      ),
                      border: InputBorder.none,
                    ),
                    items: const [
                      DropdownMenuItem(
                        value: 'user',
                        child: Row(
                          children: [
                            Icon(
                              Icons.cleaning_services,
                              size: 16,
                              color: Colors.green,
                            ),
                            SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Text('Petugas Cleaning'),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      DropdownMenuItem(
                        value: 'admin',
                        child: Row(
                          children: [
                            Icon(
                              Icons.admin_panel_settings,
                              size: 16,
                              color: Colors.blue,
                            ),
                            SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Text('Admin'),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Password Field
                _buildTextField(
                  controller: _passwordController,
                  label: 'Password',
                  hint: 'Masukkan password',
                  icon: Icons.lock,
                  isObscured: _isObscuredPassword,
                  onToggleVisibility: () {
                    setState(() {
                      _isObscuredPassword = !_isObscuredPassword;
                    });
                  },
                  validator: (value) {
                    if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
                      return 'Password tidak boleh kosong';
                    }
                    if (value.length < 6) {
                      return 'Password minimal 6 karakter';
                    }
                    return null;
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Confirm Password Field
                _buildTextField(
                  controller: _confirmPasswordController,
                  label: 'Konfirmasi Password',
                  hint: 'Ulangi password',
                  icon: Icons.lock_outline,
                  isObscured: _isObscuredConfirmPassword,
                  onToggleVisibility: () {
                    setState(() {
                      _isObscuredConfirmPassword = !_isObscuredConfirmPassword;
                    });
                  },
                  validator: (value) {
                    if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
                      return 'Konfirmasi password tidak boleh kosong';
                    }
                    if (value != _passwordController.text) {
                      return 'Password tidak cocok';
                    }
                    return null;
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 32),

                // Action Buttons
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: OutlinedButton(
                        onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: const Text('Batal'),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 16),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Obx(
                        () => ElevatedButton(
                          onPressed: _controller.isLoading.value
                              ? null
                              : _handleSubmit,
                          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF2196F3),
                            foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            ),
                          ),
                          child: _controller.isLoading.value
                              ? const SizedBox(
                                  width: 20,
                                  height: 20,
                                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                    strokeWidth: 2,
                                    valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(
                                      Colors.white,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                )
                              : const Text(
                                  'Tambah',
                                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                                ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTextField({
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required String label,
    required String hint,
    required IconData icon,
    TextInputType? keyboardType,
    String? Function(String?)? validator,
    bool isObscured = false,
    VoidCallback? onToggleVisibility,
  }) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          label,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        TextFormField(
          controller: controller,
          keyboardType: keyboardType,
          obscureText: isObscured,
          validator: validator,
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            hintText: hint,
            prefixIcon: Icon(icon, size: 20),
            suffixIcon: onToggleVisibility != null
                ? IconButton(
                    onPressed: onToggleVisibility,
                    icon: Icon(
                      isObscured ? Icons.visibility : Icons.visibility_off,
                      size: 20,
                    ),
                  )
                : null,
            border: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
            ),
            enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
            ),
            focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF2196F3)),
            ),
            errorBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Colors.red),
            ),
            focusedErrorBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Colors.red),
            ),
            contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
              horizontal: 16,
              vertical: 12,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  void _handleSubmit() async {
    if (_formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
      final success = await _controller.createUser(
        name: _nameController.text.trim(),
        phone: _phoneController.text.trim(),
        username: _usernameController.text.trim(),
        password: _passwordController.text,
        role: _selectedRole,
      );

      if (success) {
        Navigator.of(context).pop();

        // Call callback if provided
        if (widget.onUserAdded != null) {
          widget.onUserAdded!();
        }
        // Snackbar sudah ditampilkan oleh controller
      }
      // Error snackbar sudah ditampilkan oleh controller
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
class EditPetugasDialog extends StatefulWidget {

  State<EditPetugasDialog> createState() => _EditPetugasDialogState();

class _EditPetugasDialogState extends State<EditPetugasDialog> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  late TextEditingController _nameController;
  late TextEditingController _phoneController;
  late TextEditingController _usernameController;
  final _passwordController = TextEditingController();
  final _confirmPasswordController = TextEditingController();

  late String _selectedRole;
  bool _isObscuredPassword = true;
  bool _isObscuredConfirmPassword = true;
  bool _changePassword = false;

  final PetugasController _controller = Get.find<PetugasController>();

  @override

    super.initState();
    _nameController = TextEditingController(text: widget.user.name);
    _phoneController = TextEditingController(text: widget.user.phone);
    _usernameController = TextEditingController(text: widget.user.username);
    _selectedRole = widget.user.role;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameController.dispose();
    _phoneController.dispose();
    _usernameController.dispose();
    _passwordController.dispose();
    _confirmPasswordController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.7), // Dark overlay
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
      child: Container(
        width: double.maxFinite,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white, // Warna background dialog
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
              blurRadius: 15,
              offset: const Offset(0, 5),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Form(
            key: _formKey,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                // Header
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.orange.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      ),
                      child: const Icon(Icons.edit, color: Colors.orange),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    const Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        'Edit Petugas',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 18,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
                      style: IconButton.styleFrom(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                        minimumSize: const Size(32, 32),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),

                // Name Field
                _buildTextField(
                  controller: _nameController,
                  label: 'Nama Lengkap',
                  hint: 'Masukkan nama lengkap',
                  icon: Icons.person,
                  validator: (value) {
                    if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
                      return 'Nama tidak boleh kosong';
                    }
                    if (value.trim().length < 3) {
                      return 'Nama minimal 3 karakter';
                    }
                    return null;
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Phone Field
                _buildTextField(
                  controller: _phoneController,
                  label: 'No. Telepon',
                  hint: 'Masukkan nomor telepon',
                  icon: Icons.phone,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.phone,
                  validator: (value) {
                    if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
                      return 'Nomor telepon tidak boleh kosong';
                    }
                    if (value.trim().length < 10) {
                      return 'Nomor telepon minimal 10 digit';
                    }
                    return null;
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Username Field
                _buildTextField(
                  controller: _usernameController,
                  label: 'Username',
                  hint: 'Masukkan username',
                  icon: Icons.alternate_email,
                  validator: (value) {
                    if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
                      return 'Username tidak boleh kosong';
                    }
                    if (value.trim().length < 3) {
                      return 'Username minimal 3 karakter';
                    }
                    if (value.contains(' ')) {
                      return 'Username tidak boleh mengandung spasi';
                    }
                    return null;
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Role Dropdown
                const Text(
                  'Role',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Container(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
                  ),
                  child: DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                    value: _selectedRole,
                    onChanged: (value) {
                      setState(() {
                        _selectedRole = value!;
                      });
                    },
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 16,
                        vertical: 12,
                      ),
                      border: InputBorder.none,
                    ),
                    items: const [
                      DropdownMenuItem(
                        value: 'user',
                        child: Row(
                          children: [
                            Icon(
                              Icons.cleaning_services,
                              size: 16,
                              color: Colors.green,
                            ),
                            SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Text('Petugas Cleaning'),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      DropdownMenuItem(
                        value: 'admin',
                        child: Row(
                          children: [
                            Icon(
                              Icons.admin_panel_settings,
                              size: 16,
                              color: Colors.blue,
                            ),
                            SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Text('Admin'),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Change Password Checkbox
                Container(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.grey[50],
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade200),
                  ),
                  child: CheckboxListTile(
                    title: const Text(
                      'Ubah Password',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
                    ),
                    value: _changePassword,
                    onChanged: (value) {
                      setState(() {
                        _changePassword = value!;
                        if (!_changePassword) {
                          _passwordController.clear();
                          _confirmPasswordController.clear();
                        }
                      });
                    },
                    controlAffinity: ListTileControlAffinity.leading,
                    contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
                  ),
                ),

                // Password Fields (conditional)
                if (_changePassword) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  _buildTextField(
                    controller: _passwordController,
                    label: 'Password Baru',
                    hint: 'Masukkan password baru',
                    icon: Icons.lock,
                    isObscured: _isObscuredPassword,
                    onToggleVisibility: () {
                      setState(() {
                        _isObscuredPassword = !_isObscuredPassword;
                      });
                    },
                    validator: (value) {
                      if (_changePassword) {
                        if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
                          return 'Password tidak boleh kosong';
                        }
                        if (value.length < 6) {
                          return 'Password minimal 6 karakter';
                        }
                      }
                      return null;
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  _buildTextField(
                    controller: _confirmPasswordController,
                    label: 'Konfirmasi Password Baru',
                    hint: 'Ulangi password baru',
                    icon: Icons.lock_outline,
                    isObscured: _isObscuredConfirmPassword,
                    onToggleVisibility: () {
                      setState(() {
                        _isObscuredConfirmPassword =
                            !_isObscuredConfirmPassword;
                      });
                    },
                    validator: (value) {
                      if (_changePassword) {
                        if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
                          return 'Konfirmasi password tidak boleh kosong';
                        }
                        if (value != _passwordController.text) {
                          return 'Password tidak cocok';
                        }
                      }
                      return null;
                    },
                  ),
                ],

                const SizedBox(height: 32),

                // Action Buttons
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: OutlinedButton(
                        onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: const Text('Batal'),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 16),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Obx(
                        () => ElevatedButton(
                          onPressed: _controller.isLoading.value
                              ? null
                              : _handleSubmit,
                          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
                            foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            ),
                          ),
                          child: _controller.isLoading.value
                              ? const SizedBox(
                                  width: 20,
                                  height: 20,
                                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                    strokeWidth: 2,
                                    valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(
                                      Colors.white,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                )
                              : const Text(
                                  'Update',
                                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                                ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTextField({
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required String label,
    required String hint,
    required IconData icon,
    TextInputType? keyboardType,
    String? Function(String?)? validator,
    bool isObscured = false,
    VoidCallback? onToggleVisibility,
  }) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          label,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        TextFormField(
          controller: controller,
          keyboardType: keyboardType,
          obscureText: isObscured,
          validator: validator,
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            hintText: hint,
            prefixIcon: Icon(icon, size: 20),
            suffixIcon: onToggleVisibility != null
                ? IconButton(
                    onPressed: onToggleVisibility,
                    icon: Icon(
                      isObscured ? Icons.visibility : Icons.visibility_off,
                      size: 20,
                    ),
                  )
                : null,
            border: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
            ),
            enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
            ),
            focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Colors.orange),
            ),
            errorBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Colors.red),
            ),
            focusedErrorBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Colors.red),
            ),
            contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
              horizontal: 16,
              vertical: 12,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  void _handleSubmit() async {
    if (_formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
      final success = await _controller.updateUser(
        id: widget.user.id,
        name: _nameController.text.trim(),
        phone: _phoneController.text.trim(),
        username: _usernameController.text.trim(),
        role: _selectedRole,
        password: _changePassword ? _passwordController.text : null,
      );

      if (success) {
        Navigator.of(context).pop();
        // Snackbar sudah ditampilkan oleh controller
      }
      // Error snackbar sudah ditampilkan oleh controller
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import '../controllers/petugas_controller.dart';
import '../../../../../../data/models/user.dart';
import 'edit_petugas_dialog.dart';

class PetugasListWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  const PetugasListWidget({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final controller = Get.find<PetugasController>();

    return Obx(() {
      if (controller.isLoading.value) {
        return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
      }

      if (controller.errorMessage.isNotEmpty) {
        return Center(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.error_outline, size: 64, color: Colors.red[300]),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),

                'Terjadi Kesalahan',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 18,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,

              Text(

                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.grey[600]),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              ElevatedButton.icon(
                onPressed: () => controller.loadUsers(),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
                label: const Text('Coba Lagi'),
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF2196F3),
                  foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      }

      if (controller.staffList.isEmpty) {
        return Center(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.people_outline, size: 64, color: Colors.grey[400]),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Text(
                'Belum Ada Data Petugas',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 18,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: Colors.grey[600],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                'Tambahkan petugas pertama dengan menekan tombol tambah',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.grey[500]),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,

            ],
          ),
        );
      }

      return Column(
        children: controller.staffList
            .map((staff) => _buildStaffCard(context, staff))
            .toList(),
      );
    });
  }

  Widget _buildStaffCard(BuildContext context, User staff) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.15),
            blurRadius: 12,
            offset: const Offset(0, 4),

          ),
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.05),
            blurRadius: 6,
            offset: const Offset(0, 1),
          ),
        ],
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade100),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          // Avatar
          Container(
            width: 50,
            height: 50,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: staff.isAdmin
                  ? const Color(0xFF2196F3)

              child: Text(
                _getInitials(staff.name),

          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 16),

                  children: [

                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,

                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 8,
                        vertical: 2,

                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: staff.isAdmin
                            ? Colors.blue[100]
                            : Colors.green[100],

  String _getInitials(String name) {
    final names = name.split(' ');
    if (names.length >= 2) {
      return (names[0][0] + names[1][0]).toUpperCase();
    } else if (names.isNotEmpty) {
      return names[0][0].toUpperCase();
    }
    return 'U';
  }

      context: context,
      builder: (context) => EditPetugasDialog(user: staff),

            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            const Expanded(

              style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey[600]),

            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.grey[50],
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade200),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    staff.name,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      fontSize: 16,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(staff.phone, style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey[600])),
                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
                  Text(
                    '@${staff.username}',
                    style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey[500], fontSize: 12),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              'Tindakan ini tidak dapat dibatalkan.',
              style: TextStyle(
                color: Colors.red[600],
                fontSize: 12,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
            child: const Text('Batal'),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Obx(() {
            final controller = Get.find<PetugasController>();
            return ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: controller.isLoading.value
                  ? null
                  : () => _handleDelete(context, staff),
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: Colors.red,
                foregroundColor: Colors.white,
              ),
              child: controller.isLoading.value
                  ? const SizedBox(
                      width: 16,
                      height: 16,
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                        strokeWidth: 2,
                        valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(Colors.white),
                      ),
                    )
                  : const Text('Hapus'),
            );
          }),
        ],
      ),

  }

  void _handleDelete(BuildContext context, User user) async {
    final controller = Get.find<PetugasController>();
    await controller.deleteUser(user);

    Navigator.of(context).pop(); // Close dialog
    // Snackbar sudah ditampilkan oleh controller
  }
}
```

Ah, notifikasi tidak muncul karena **backend `.env` belum dikonfigurasi Firebase Server Key**! 🔥

## 🔍 PENYEBAB NOTIFIKASI TIDAK MUNCUL:

Backend perlu **Firebase Server Key** untuk mengirim notifikasi ke device.

---

## ✅ SOLUSI - Tambahkan Firebase Server Key ke Backend

### **Step 1: Ambil Server Key dari Firebase Console**

1. Buka: https://console.firebase.google.com
2. Pilih project **"bps-cleaning-system"**
3. Klik ⚙️ (Settings) → **Project settings**
4. Tab **"Cloud Messaging"**
5. Scroll ke bawah, cari section **"Cloud Messaging API (Legacy)"**
6. Copy **Server key** (format: `AAAA...xxxxx`)

### **Step 2: Tambahkan ke Backend `.env`**

Baik, karena file `.env` tidak bisa dibaca (biasanya di-gitignore), saya akan beri tahu Anda apa yang harus ditambahkan:

### **Edit file `backend/.env`**, tambahkan baris ini di bagian paling bawah:

```env
# Firebase Cloud Messaging
FIREBASE_SERVER_KEY=AAAA_your_server_key_here
```

**Contoh lengkap:**
```env
FIREBASE_SERVER_KEY=AAAAxxx123:AP91bHPlxxxxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

---

## 📝 LANGKAH LENGKAP:

### **1. Buka File Backend `.env`**
```
D:\Project\bpsCleaningSystem\bps_cleaning_system\backend\.env
```

### **2. Tambahkan di bagian bawah:**
```env
# Firebase Cloud Messaging
FIREBASE_SERVER_KEY=<paste_server_key_dari_firebase_console>
```

### **3. Restart Backend Server** (PENTING!)
```bash
cd backend
php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8000
```

⚠️ Pastikan pakai `--host=0.0.0.0` agar bisa diakses dari HP!

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class FCMService
{
    private const FCM_URL_V1 = 'https://fcm.googleapis.com/v1/projects/%s/messages:send';
    
    /**
     * Send notification to specific user(s)
     */
    public static function sendToUser($fcmToken, string $title, string $body, array $data = [])
    {
        if (empty($fcmToken)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $tokens = is_array($fcmToken) ? $fcmToken : [$fcmToken];
        $tokens = array_filter($tokens); // Remove null values
        
        if (empty($tokens)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $notification = [
            'title' => $title,
            'body' => $body,
            'sound' => 'default',
            'badge' => '1',
        ];
        
        $payload = [
            'registration_ids' => $tokens,
            'notification' => $notification,
            'data' => $data,
            'priority' => 'high',
        ];
        
        return self::send($payload);
    }
    
    /**
     * Send notification to all users with specific role
     */
    public static function sendToRole(string $role, string $title, string $body, array $data = [])
    {
        $users = \App\Models\User::where('role', $role)
            ->whereNotNull('fcm_token')
            ->pluck('fcm_token')
            ->toArray();
        
        if (empty($users)) {
            Log::info("No users found with role: $role");
            return false;
        }
        
        return self::sendToUser($users, $title, $body, $data);
    }
    
    /**
     * Send FCM request
     */
    private static function send(array $payload): bool
    {
        try {
            $projectId = env('FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID');
            $accessToken = self::getAccessToken();

            if (!$projectId || !$accessToken) {
                Log::error('FCM v1 missing configuration (FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID or service account)');
                return false;
            }

            $response = Http::withHeaders([
                'Authorization' => 'Bearer ' . $accessToken,
                'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            ])->post(sprintf(self::FCM_URL_V1, $projectId), [
                'message' => [
                    'token' => $payload['registration_ids'][0] ?? null,
                    'tokens' => $payload['registration_ids'] ?? null,
                    'notification' => $payload['notification'] ?? null,
                    'data' => $payload['data'] ?? null,
                    'android' => [ 'priority' => 'HIGH' ],
                ],
            ]);
            
            if ($response->successful()) {
                Log::info('FCM notification sent successfully', ['payload' => $payload]);
                return true;
            }
            
            Log::error('FCM notification failed', [
                'status' => $response->status(),
                'body' => $response->body(),
            ]);
            
            return false;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('FCM notification error: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static function getAccessToken(): ?string
    {
        try {
            $scopes = ['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/firebase.messaging'];
            $keyFile = env('GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS');
            if (!$keyFile || !file_exists($keyFile)) {
                Log::error('Service account JSON not found. Set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS path in .env');
                return null;
            }
            $client = new \Google\Auth\OAuth2(['audience' => '']);
            $creds = new \Google\Auth\Credentials\ServiceAccountCredentials($scopes, $keyFile);
            $token = $creds->fetchAuthToken();
            return $token['access_token'] ?? null;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('Failed generating Google access token: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return null;
        }
    }
}


```

Betul, Legacy sudah tidak dipakai. Saya sudah ubah backend ke FCM HTTP v1.

Yang perlu Anda lakukan:

1) Buat Service Account (JSON)
- Firebase Console → Project settings → Service accounts
- Klik “Generate new private key” → simpan file JSON
- Letakkan misalnya di: backend/storage/firebase-service-account.json

2) Tambah ENV di backend/.env
```env
FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=bps-cleaning-system
GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/full/path/ke/backend/storage/firebase-service-account.json
```

3) Install dependency dan clear config
```bash
cd backend
composer install
php artisan config:clear
php artisan cache:clear
php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8000
```

4) Re-login app pada device agar fcm_token tersimpan.

Catatan:
- Notifikasi akan terkirim saat: generate tugas (ke user), user kirim laporan (ke admin), dan admin review (ke user).

```plaintext
FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=bps-cleaning-system
GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/full/path/ke/backend/storage/firebase-service-account.json
```

```shellscript
cd backend
composer install
php artisan config:clear
php artisan cache:clear
php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8000
```
